hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैं उन फ़ैसलों को याद करता हूँ जो तूने बहुत पहले किए थे, और उनसे मुझे तसल्ली मिलती है।

ru.L: Я вспоминаю {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} правила издревле, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, и утешаюсь.
ru.B: Я привожу на память {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} правила, данные давным-давно, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, и нахожу утешение.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, я вспоминаю решения, которые {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} принял давным-давно, и они меня утешают.

uk.L: Я згадую {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} присуди з давніх-давен, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, і втішаюся.
uk.B: Я пригадую {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} давні присуди, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, і знаходжу розраду.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, я памʼятаю рішення, які {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} ухвалив давно, і вони мене втішають.

decisions.choice: judgments: God's rulings, his decisions about what is right
decisions.reason: As in 119:7.

decisions.choice: from of old: given long ago
decisions.reason: The word ('olam) is time beyond memory. God's rulings were given long ago and have stood ever since.
The verb (hitnachem) is to find comfort for oneself.

records.literal_gloss: Burning rage has seized me because of [the] wicked, [who] forsake your instruction.

en.L: Burning anger has seized me because of the wicked, who forsake {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction.
en.B: Because of the wicked, who have abandoned {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction, a hot anger takes hold of me.
en.R: I am filled with anger because of wicked people who turn their backs on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} teaching.

fr.L: Une colère brûlante m’a saisi à cause des méchants, qui abandonnent {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi.
fr.B: À cause des méchants, qui ont abandonné {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} instruction, une colère ardente s’empare de moi.
fr.R: Je suis rempli de colère à cause des méchants qui tournent le dos à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} enseignement.

sw.L: Hasira kali imenishika kwa sababu ya waovu, wanaoyaacha mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Kwa sababu ya waovu, walioyaacha mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, hasira kali inanishika.
sw.R: Nimejaa hasira kwa sababu ya watu waovu wanaoyapa kisogo mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

es.L: Un ardor de ira se ha apoderado de mí a causa de los malvados, que abandonan {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción.
es.B: Por causa de los malvados, que han dejado {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción, me domina una ira ardiente.
es.R: Me lleno de enojo por culpa de los malvados, que le dan la espalda a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} enseñanza.

vi.L: Cơn giận nóng bỏng đã chiếm lấy tôi vì những kẻ ác, là những kẻ lìa bỏ sự dạy dỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vì những kẻ ác đã từ bỏ lời dạy dỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, cơn giận nóng bừng nắm lấy tôi.
vi.R: Tôi đầy giận dữ vì những kẻ ác quay lưng với lời dạy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 주님의 가르침을 버리는 악인들 때문에 타오르는 분노가 저를 사로잡았습니다.
ko.B: 주님의 가르침을 저버린 악인들 때문에 뜨거운 분노가 저를 사로잡습니다.
ko.R: 주님의 가르침에 등을 돌리는 악한 사람들 때문에 저는 화가 치밀어 오릅니다.

pt.L: Uma ira ardente se apoderou de mim por causa dos ímpios, que abandonam o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} ensino.
pt.B: Por causa dos ímpios, que deixaram o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} ensino, uma indignação ardente me domina.
pt.R: Fico cheio de raiva por causa das pessoas más que dão as costas aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} ensinamentos.

am.L: ሕግህን ከሚተዉ ክፉዎች የተነሣ የሚያቃጥል ቁጣ ያዘኝ።
am.B: ሕግህን ከተዉት ክፉዎች የተነሣ ኃይለኛ ቁጣ ይይዘኛል።
am.R: ሕግህን ከሚተዉ ክፉ ሰዎች የተነሣ በቁጣ እሞላለሁ።

hi.L: धधकते क्रोध ने मुझे जकड़ लिया है, दुष्टों के कारण, जो तेरी व्यवस्था को त्याग देते हैं।
hi.B: उन दुष्टों के कारण, जिन्होंने तेरी व्यवस्था को छोड़ दिया है, मुझ पर तीव्र क्रोध छा जाता है।
hi.R: दुष्ट लोग तेरी शिक्षा से मुँह फेर लेते हैं, इस कारण मैं क्रोध से भर जाता हूँ।

ru.L: Палящий гнев охватил меня из-за нечестивых, оставляющих {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} Закон.
ru.B: Из-за нечестивых, которые оставили {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} Закон, меня охватывает жгучий гнев.
ru.R: Я полон гнева из-за злых людей, которые отворачиваются от {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} наставления.

uk.L: Палючий гнів охопив мене через нечестивих, що покидають {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} настанову.
uk.B: Через нечестивих, які покинули {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} настанову, мене охоплює гарячий гнів.
uk.R: Я сповнений гніву через злих людей, які відвертаються від {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} навчання.

decisions.reason: The word (zal'afah) is a burning heat, used of the scorching wind in 11:6. Here it is the psalmist's anger, or horror, at people who abandon God's instruction.
The verb ('azav) is the one in verse 8.
As in 119:1.

decisions.choice: "악인들" (L, B), "악한 사람들" (R) for the wicked, throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: As the terms note and Psalm 1.

records.literal_gloss: Songs have been to me your statutes in [the] house of my sojournings.

en.L: Songs {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes have been to me, in the house of my sojourning.
en.B: Your statutes have become my songs in every place where I live as a foreigner.
en.R: Wherever I live as a stranger, I sing about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} laws.

fr.L: Tes prescriptions ont été pour moi des chants, dans la maison où je séjourne en étranger.
fr.B: Tes prescriptions sont devenues mes chants en tout lieu où je vis en étranger.
fr.R: Partout où je vis en étranger, je chante {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lois.

sw.L: Nyimbo zimekuwa kwangu kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, katika nyumba ya ugeni wangu.
sw.B: Kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zimekuwa nyimbo zangu kila mahali ninapoishi kama mgeni.
sw.R: Popote ninapoishi kama mgeni, ninaimba juu ya kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

es.L: Cánticos me han sido {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} estatutos en la casa de mi peregrinación.
es.B: Tus estatutos se han vuelto mis canciones en cada lugar donde vivo como extranjero.
es.R: Dondequiera que vivo como forastero, canto sobre {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} leyes.

vi.L: Các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã là những bài ca cho tôi, trong nhà [nơi] tôi kiều ngụ.
vi.B: Các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã trở thành bài ca của tôi ở mọi nơi tôi sống như một người ngoại kiều.
vi.R: Dù tôi sống như người khách lạ ở bất cứ nơi đâu, tôi vẫn ca hát về luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 노래가 되었습니다, 주님의 규례들이 저에게, 제가 나그네로 사는 집에서.
ko.B: 제가 나그네로 머무는 곳마다 주님의 규례가 저의 노래가 되었습니다.
ko.R: 제가 어디에서 낯선 사람으로 살든지, 저는 주님의 법을 노래합니다.

pt.L: Cânticos foram para mim os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} estatutos, na casa onde vivo como imigrante.
pt.B: Os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} estatutos se tornaram as minhas canções em todo lugar onde vivo como estrangeiro.
pt.R: Onde quer que eu more como estrangeiro, eu canto sobre as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} leis.

am.L: ሥርዓቶችህ መዝሙሮች ሆኑልኝ፣ በመጻተኛነቴ ቤት።
am.B: መጻተኛ ሆኜ በምኖርበት ስፍራ ሁሉ ሥርዓቶችህ መዝሙሮቼ ሆነዋል።
am.R: እንደ እንግዳ በምኖርበት ቦታ ሁሉ ስለ ሥርዓቶችህ እዘምራለሁ።

hi.L: मेरे परदेशवास के घर में तेरी विधियाँ मेरे लिए गीत बनी रही हैं।
hi.B: जहाँ-जहाँ मैं परदेशी होकर रहता हूँ, वहाँ तेरी विधियाँ मेरे गीत बन गई हैं।
hi.R: मैं जहाँ भी परदेशी बनकर रहता हूँ, वहाँ तेरी विधियों के गीत गाता हूँ।

ru.L: Песнями стали мне {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} установления в доме моего странствия.
ru.B: Твои установления стали моими песнями везде, где я живу как чужеземец.
ru.R: Где бы я ни жил чужаком, я пою о {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} законах.

uk.L: Піснями стали для мене {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} постанови в домі мого чужинства.
uk.B: Твої постанови стали моїми піснями в кожному місці, де я живу як чужинець.
uk.R: Хоч би де я жив як чужинець, я співаю про {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} закони.

decisions.reason: The word (zemirot) is used of songs with instruments (95:2).

decisions.choice: statutes: rules that are fixed and laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:5.

decisions.choice: the house of my sojourning: wherever I live as a foreigner
decisions.reason: The psalmist calls himself a sojourner (verse 19); the house of his sojourning is his life on earth, lived as a foreigner who is only passing through (39:13).

decisions.choice: every place where I live as a foreigner (B); wherever I live as a stranger (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the phrase means.
Literal keeps "songs" at the head of the verse, as the Hebrew does; Korean poetry allows the subject and place to follow the verb.

source.text: זָ֘כַ֤רְתִּי בַלַּ֣יְלָה שִׁמְךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה וָֽ֝אֶשְׁמְרָ֗ה תּוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: I have remembered in the night your name, YHWH, and I have kept your instruction.

en.L: I remember in the night {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and I keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction.
en.B: Through the night I think of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, and I hold to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, at night I think about who {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are, and I obey {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} teaching.

fr.L: Je me souviens dans la nuit de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et je garde {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi.
fr.B: Pendant la nuit je pense à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, et je m’attache à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} instruction.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, la nuit, je pense à qui {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es, et j’obéis à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} enseignement.

sw.L: Ninalikumbuka usiku jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nami nayashika mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Usiku kucha ninalifikiria jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nami ninashikamana na mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, usiku ninafikiria jinsi {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ulivyo, nami ninayatii mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

es.L: Recuerdo en la noche {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y guardo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción.
es.B: Durante la noche pienso en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} nombre, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, y me mantengo fiel a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, de noche pienso en quién eres {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, y obedezco {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} enseñanza.

vi.L: Tôi nhớ đến danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trong đêm, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và tôi giữ sự dạy dỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Suốt đêm tôi nghĩ đến danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và tôi giữ vững lời dạy dỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, ban đêm tôi suy nghĩ về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng thế nào, và tôi vâng theo lời dạy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 제가 밤에 주님의 이름을 기억합니다, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 그리고 주님의 가르침을 지킵니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 밤새도록 저는 주님의 이름을 생각하며 주님의 가르침을 굳게 지킵니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 밤에 저는 주님께서 어떤 분이신지 생각하고, 주님의 가르침을 따릅니다.

pt.L: Lembro-me de noite do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, e guardo o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} ensino.
pt.B: Durante a noite penso no {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} nome, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, e me apego ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} ensino.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, de noite eu penso em quem {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és, e obedeço aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} ensinamentos.

am.L: በሌሊት ስምህን አስታውሳለሁ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፤ ሕግህንም እጠብቃለሁ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ሌሊቱን ሁሉ ስምህን አስባለሁ፤ ሕግህንም እጠብቃለሁ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ በሌሊት አንተ ማን እንደሆንክ አስባለሁ፤ ሕግህንም እጠብቃለሁ።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, रात में मैं तेरे नाम को स्मरण करता हूँ, और तेरी व्यवस्था का पालन करता हूँ।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, रात भर मैं तेरे नाम के बारे में सोचता हूँ, और तेरी व्यवस्था को थामे रहता हूँ।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, रात को मैं सोचता हूँ कि तू कौन है, और मैं तेरी शिक्षा का पालन करता हूँ।

ru.L: Я вспоминаю ночью {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} имя, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, и храню {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} Закон.
ru.B: Всю ночь я думаю о {{deity_pronoun:твоём|Твоём}} имени, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, и держусь {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} Закона.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, ночью я думаю о том, кто {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}, и исполняю {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} наставление.

uk.L: Я згадую вночі {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, і бережу {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} настанову.
uk.B: Усю ніч я думаю про {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} імʼя, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, і тримаюся {{deity_pronoun:твоєї|Твоєї}} настанови.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, уночі я думаю про те, який {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} є, і слухаюся {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} навчання.

decisions.choice: your name: God himself as he has made himself known
decisions.reason: A name stood for the person and what he had shown himself to be (5:12; 20:2).
As in 119:1.
The verb is past in form; it describes what the psalmist has done and still does, so it is rendered with the present, like "remember".
Readable says what the name stands for (m1).

records.literal_gloss: This has been to me, that your precepts I have kept.

en.L: This has been mine: that I have kept {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.B: This has been my part in life: I have held to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.R: This is how I have lived: I have obeyed {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instructions.

fr.L: Ceci a été pour moi : que j’ai gardé {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.B: Voilà quelle a été ma part dans la vie : je me suis attaché à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.R: Voici comment j’ai vécu : j’ai obéi à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} consignes.

sw.L: Hili limekuwa langu: kwamba nimeyashika maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Hili limekuwa fungu langu maishani: nimeyashika maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Hivi ndivyo nilivyoishi: nimeyatii maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

es.L: Esto ha sido mío: que he guardado {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} preceptos.
es.B: Esta ha sido mi parte en la vida: me he mantenido fiel a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} preceptos.
es.R: Así es como he vivido: he obedecido {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} instrucciones.

vi.L: Điều này đã thuộc về tôi: rằng tôi đã giữ các huấn lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Đây là phần của tôi trong đời: tôi đã giữ vững các huấn lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Tôi đã sống như thế này: tôi đã vâng theo những lời chỉ dẫn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 이것이 제 것이 되었습니다, 제가 주님의 법도들을 지킨 것이.
ko.B: 이것이 제 삶의 몫이었습니다. 저는 주님의 법도를 굳게 지켰습니다.
ko.R: 저는 이렇게 살아왔습니다. 주님의 지시를 따랐습니다.

pt.L: Isto tem sido meu: que guardei os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} preceitos.
pt.B: Esta tem sido a minha parte na vida: eu me apeguei aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} preceitos.
pt.R: É assim que tenho vivido: tenho obedecido às {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} instruções.

am.L: ይህ የእኔ ሆነልኝ፤ መመሪያዎችህን ማክበሬ።
am.B: በሕይወቴ ድርሻዬ ይህ ሆኗል፤ መመሪያዎችህን አክብሬአለሁ።
am.R: የኖርኩት እንዲህ ነው፤ መመሪያዎችህን አክብሬአለሁ።

hi.L: यह मेरा [भाग] रहा है: कि मैंने तेरे आदेशों का पालन किया है।
hi.B: जीवन में यही मेरा भाग रहा है: मैं तेरे आदेशों को थामे रहा हूँ।
hi.R: मैंने इसी तरह जीवन बिताया है: मैंने तेरे निर्देशों का पालन किया है।

ru.L: Это было моим: то, что я хранил {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} наказы.
ru.B: Вот какой была моя доля в жизни: я держался {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} наказов.
ru.R: Вот как я жил: я исполнял {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} указания.

uk.L: Це стало моїм: що я беріг {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} накази.
uk.B: Це була моя частка в житті: я тримався {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} наказів.
uk.R: Ось як я жив: я слухався {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} вказівок.

decisions.choice: this has been mine: this is what I have
alternatives: this has happened to me because I kept your precepts
decisions.reason: The Hebrew is short and can be read two ways: keeping God's precepts is what the psalmist has as his own (as "my portion" in verse 57), or the comfort of verses 52-55 came to him because he kept them.

decisions.choice: precepts: the charges God has laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:4.
As in 119:2.

records.literal_gloss: My portion [is] YHWH; I have said to keep your words.

en.L: My portion [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; I have said [that I would] keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} words.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is my share in life; I have said that I will hold to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} words.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is all I need. I have promised to obey {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} words.

fr.L: Ma part, [c’est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; j’ai dit [que je] garderais {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} paroles.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est ma part dans la vie ; j’ai dit que je m’attacherais à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} paroles.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est tout ce dont j’ai besoin. J’ai promis d’obéir à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} paroles.

sw.L: Fungu langu [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; nimesema [kwamba nitayashika] maneno {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye fungu langu maishani; nimesema kwamba nitayashika maneno {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ndiye kila kitu ninachohitaji. Nimeahidi kuyatii maneno {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

es.L: Mi porción [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; he dicho [que] guardaré {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} palabras.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es mi herencia en la vida; he dicho que me mantendré fiel a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} palabras.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es todo lo que necesito. He prometido obedecer {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} palabras.

vi.L: Phần của tôi [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; tôi đã nói [rằng tôi sẽ] giữ các lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là phần của tôi trong đời; tôi đã nói rằng tôi sẽ giữ vững các lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là tất cả những gì tôi cần. Tôi đã hứa vâng theo các lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 저의 몫은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이십니다. 제가 주님의 말씀들을 지키겠다고 말하였습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 제 삶의 몫이십니다. 저는 주님의 말씀을 지키겠다고 말씀드렸습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}만 계시면 저는 부족함이 없습니다. 저는 주님의 말씀을 따르겠다고 약속했습니다.

pt.L: A minha porção [é] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}; eu disse [que] guardaria as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} palavras.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é a minha parte na vida; eu disse que me apegaria às {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} palavras.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é tudo de que eu preciso. Prometi obedecer às {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} palavras.

am.L: ድርሻዬ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} [ነው]፤ ቃሎችህን እጠብቅ ዘንድ አልኩ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሕይወቴ ድርሻዬ ነው፤ ቃሎችህን እጠብቃለሁ ብያለሁ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} የሚያስፈልገኝ ሁሉ ነው። ቃሎችህን እጠብቃለሁ ብዬ ተናግሬአለሁ።

hi.L: मेरा भाग {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} [हैं]; मैंने कहा है [कि मैं] तेरे वचनों का पालन [करूँगा]।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ही जीवन में मेरा हिस्सा हैं; मैंने कहा है कि मैं तेरे वचनों को थामे रहूँगा।
hi.R: मुझे बस {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} चाहिए। मैंने ठान लिया है कि मैं तेरे वचनों का पालन करूँगा।

ru.L: Моя доля — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}; я сказал, [что] буду хранить {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} слова.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — моя доля в жизни; я сказал, что буду держаться {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} слов.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} — это всё, что мне нужно. Я обещал исполнять {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} слова.

uk.L: Моя частка — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}}; я сказав, [що] берегтиму {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} слова.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — моя частка в житті; я сказав, що триматимусь {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} слів.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} — це все, чого я потребую. Я пообіцяв слухатися {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} слів.

decisions.reason: Each of the eight verses of this stanza begins with the letter heth, the eighth letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see 119:1).

decisions.choice: my portion: my share, what I have
decisions.reason: The tribe of Levi received no land, for the LORD was its portion (Numbers 18:20). The psalmist says the same of himself (16:5; 73:26).

alternatives: My portion, LORD, I have said, is to keep your words
decisions.reason: The name may be the subject ("the LORD is my portion") or a call to God ("my portion, LORD, ..."). The psalm otherwise speaks to God, but the first reading is the plainer.

decisions.choice: I have said: I have promised
decisions.reason: To say that one will do something is to promise it.
As in 119:9; here the word is plural.
Readable says what the picture means.

records.literal_gloss: I have entreated your face with all [the] heart; be gracious to me according to your saying.

en.L: I have entreated {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} face with all [the] heart; be gracious to me according to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} saying.
en.B: With my whole heart I have pleaded for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} favor; show me kindness, just as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} promise said.
en.R: I have begged {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} with all my heart to be kind to me. Show me {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} kindness, just as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} promise said.

fr.L: J’ai imploré {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} face de tout cœur ; fais-moi grâce selon {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} propos.
fr.B: De tout mon cœur j’ai supplié pour obtenir {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} faveur ; montre-moi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bonté, comme {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} promesse l’a dit.
fr.R: Je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}ai supplié de tout mon cœur d’être bon pour moi. Montre-moi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bonté, comme {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} promesse l’a dit.

sw.L: Nimeusihi uso {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} kwa moyo wote; unifadhili kulingana na kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Kwa moyo wangu wote nimeomba kibali {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}}; unionyeshe wema, kama kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ilivyosema.
sw.R: Nimekusihi kwa moyo wangu wote unionee huruma. Unionyeshe wema {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, kama kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ilivyosema.

es.L: He suplicado ante {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} rostro con todo [el] corazón; ten piedad de mí conforme a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dicho.
es.B: Con todo mi corazón he implorado {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} favor; muéstrame bondad, tal como dijo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} promesa.
es.R: Te he rogado con todo mi corazón que seas bueno conmigo. Muéstrame {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} bondad, tal como dijo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} promesa.

vi.L: Tôi đã nài xin trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với trọn lòng; xin thương xót tôi theo lời phán của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Tôi đã hết lòng nài xin ơn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; xin tỏ lòng nhân từ với tôi, đúng như lời hứa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Tôi đã hết lòng nài xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tỏ lòng tốt với tôi. Xin bày tỏ lòng tốt của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với tôi, đúng như lời hứa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 제가 온 마음으로 주님의 얼굴을 간절히 구하였습니다. 주님께서 하신 말씀대로 저에게 은혜를 베풀어 주십시오.
ko.B: 저는 온 마음을 다해 주님의 은총을 간구했습니다. 주님께서 약속하신 대로 저에게 은혜를 베풀어 주십시오.
ko.R: 저는 온 마음으로 주님께 은혜를 베풀어 달라고 간절히 빌었습니다. 주님께서 약속하신 대로 저에게 은혜를 보여 주십시오.

pt.L: Implorei diante da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} face de todo [o] coração; sê gracioso para comigo conforme o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} dito.
pt.B: De todo o coração implorei o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} favor; mostra-me a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} graça, como a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} promessa disse.
pt.R: Eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} pedi com todo o meu coração que fosses bondoso comigo. Sê bondoso comigo, como a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} promessa disse.

am.L: በሙሉ ልብ ፊትህን ለመንኩ፤ እንደ ንግግርህ ራራልኝ።
am.B: በሙሉ ልቤ ሞገስህን ለመንኩ፤ ተስፋ ቃልህ እንደተናገረው ቸርነትን አድርግልኝ።
am.R: ቸር እንድትሆንልኝ በሙሉ ልቤ ለመንኩህ። ተስፋ ቃልህ እንደሚለው ቸርነትህን አሳየኝ።

hi.L: मैंने पूरे मन से तेरे मुख के आगे विनती की है; अपने कथन के अनुसार मुझ पर अनुग्रह कर।
hi.B: मैंने पूरे मन से तेरी कृपा के लिए विनती की है; जैसा तेरी प्रतिज्ञा ने कहा था, वैसे ही मुझ पर दया कर।
hi.R: मैंने पूरे मन से तुझसे बिनती की है कि तू मुझ पर दया करे। जैसा तेरी प्रतिज्ञा ने कहा था, मुझ पर अपनी दया दिखा।

ru.L: Я умолял {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} лицо всем сердцем; помилуй меня по {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} речению.
ru.B: От всего сердца я молил {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} о милости; будь добр ко мне, как сказано в {{deity_pronoun:твоём|Твоём}} обещании.
ru.R: Я всем сердцем просил {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} быть добрым ко мне. Будь добр ко мне, как и говорит {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} обещание.

uk.L: Я благав {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} обличчя всім серцем; будь милостивий до мене за {{deity_pronoun:твоїм|Твоїм}} висловом.
uk.B: Усім серцем я благав про {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} прихильність; вияви мені доброту, як сказала {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} обіцянка.
uk.R: Я всім серцем благав {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} бути добрим до мене. Вияви мені {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} доброту, як {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} обіцяв.

decisions.choice: entreat your face: plead for your favor
decisions.reason: The phrase (chillah panim) is to soften someone's face, to seek favor from a ruler or from God (Exodus 32:11).
The verb (chanan) is to show kindness that is not owed.

decisions.choice: saying: what God has said, often his promise

records.literal_gloss: I have thought about my ways, and I have turned my feet to your testimonies.

en.L: I have considered my ways, and I have turned my feet to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} testimonies.
en.B: I have thought hard about how I live, and turned my steps back to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} decrees.
en.R: I thought about the way I was living, and I turned back to do what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have declared.

fr.L: J’ai considéré mes voies, et j’ai tourné mes pieds vers {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} témoignages.
fr.B: J’ai bien réfléchi à ma façon de vivre, et j’ai ramené mes pas vers {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décrets.
fr.R: J’ai réfléchi à la façon dont je vivais, et je suis revenu faire ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as déclaré.

sw.L: Nimezifikiria njia zangu, nami nimeigeuza miguu yangu kwenye shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Nimeufikiria sana mwenendo wangu, nikazirudisha hatua zangu kwenye shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Nilifikiria jinsi nilivyokuwa nikiishi, nikarudi kufanya yale ambayo shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zinasema.

es.L: He considerado mis caminos, y he vuelto mis pies a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} testimonios.
es.B: He pensado bien en cómo vivo, y he vuelto mis pasos hacia {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} decretos.
es.R: Pensé en la manera en que vivía, y me volví para hacer lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has declarado.

vi.L: Tôi đã suy xét các đường lối của tôi, và tôi đã quay chân tôi về các lời chứng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Tôi đã suy nghĩ kỹ về cách mình sống, và quay bước trở về với các lời chứng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Tôi đã nghĩ về cách tôi đang sống, và tôi đã quay trở lại để làm theo những điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã công bố.

ko.L: 제가 제 길들을 생각해 보고, 제 발을 주님의 증언들로 돌렸습니다.
ko.B: 저는 제가 사는 모습을 깊이 돌아보고, 주님의 증언으로 발걸음을 돌이켰습니다.
ko.R: 저는 제가 어떻게 살고 있는지 생각해 보고, 주님께서 알려 주신 뜻대로 살려고 돌아섰습니다.

pt.L: Considerei os meus caminhos e voltei os meus pés para os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} testemunhos.
pt.B: Pensei bem no modo como vivo e fiz os meus passos voltarem aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} decretos.
pt.R: Pensei no jeito como eu estava vivendo e voltei a fazer o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} declaraste.

am.L: መንገዶቼን አሰብኩ፤ እግሮቼንም ወደ ምስክርነቶችህ መለስኩ።
am.B: አኗኗሬን በጥንቃቄ አሰብኩ፤ እርምጃዬንም ወደ ምስክርነቶችህ መለስኩ።
am.R: እንዴት እንደምኖር አሰብኩ፤ ምስክርነቶችህን ለመከተልም ተመለስኩ።

hi.L: मैंने अपने मार्गों पर सोच-विचार किया है, और अपने पाँव तेरी चितौनियों की ओर फेरे हैं।
hi.B: मैंने गहराई से सोचा कि मैं कैसे जी रहा हूँ, और अपने कदम फिर से तेरी चितौनियों की ओर मोड़ दिए।
hi.R: मैंने सोचा कि मैं कैसे जी रहा था, और मैं लौट आया ताकि तेरी घोषणाओं के अनुसार चलूँ।

ru.L: Я обдумал мои пути и обратил мои ноги к {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} свидетельствам.
ru.B: Я хорошо поразмыслил о том, как живу, и снова направил свои шаги к {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} постановлениям.
ru.R: Я подумал о том, как живу, и вернулся к тому, чтобы исполнять то, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} возвестил.

uk.L: Я обміркував мої дороги і повернув мої ноги до {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} свідчень.
uk.B: Я добре подумав про те, як живу, і повернув свої кроки назад до {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} свідчень.
uk.R: Я подумав, як я живу, і повернувся, щоб робити те, що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} проголосив.

decisions.reason: Turning the feet is a picture of turning back to God, of repentance.

decisions.choice: testimonies: what God has solemnly declared
decisions.reason: As in 119:2.
Balanced and Readable bring out that this is a turning back.

records.literal_gloss: I have hurried and not delayed to keep your commands.

en.L: I have hurried and not delayed to keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.
en.B: Quickly, without waiting, I set myself to keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.
en.R: I hurry to obey {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands. I do not wait.

fr.L: Je me suis hâté et je n’ai pas tardé à garder {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.B: Vite, sans attendre, je me suis mis à garder {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.R: Je me dépêche d’obéir à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements. Je n’attends pas.

sw.L: Nimefanya haraka wala sikukawia kuzishika amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Kwa haraka, bila kungoja, ninajitahidi kuzishika amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Ninafanya haraka kuzitii amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}. Sikawii.

es.L: Me he apresurado y no me he demorado en guardar {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos.
es.B: De prisa, sin esperar, me he puesto a cumplir {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos.
es.R: Me apresuro a obedecer {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos. No espero.

vi.L: Tôi đã vội vàng và không chần chừ để giữ các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Tôi mau mắn, không chút chậm trễ, quyết tâm gìn giữ các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Tôi vội vàng vâng theo các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Tôi không chần chừ.

ko.L: 제가 서둘렀고, 주님의 계명들을 지키기를 미루지 않았습니다.
ko.B: 저는 머뭇거리지 않고 서둘러 주님의 계명을 지키려 합니다.
ko.R: 저는 서둘러 주님의 명령을 따릅니다. 미루지 않습니다.

pt.L: Apressei-me e não demorei em guardar os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} mandamentos.
pt.B: Depressa, sem hesitar, tratei de guardar os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} mandamentos.
pt.R: Eu me apresso para obedecer aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} mandamentos. Não fico esperando.

am.L: ትእዛዛትህን ለመጠበቅ ቸኮልኩ፤ አልዘገየሁምም።
am.B: ሳልዘገይ ፈጥኜ ትእዛዛትህን ለመጠበቅ ተነሣሁ።
am.R: ትእዛዛትህን ለመጠበቅ እቸኩላለሁ። አልዘገይም።

hi.L: मैंने फुर्ती की और देर नहीं की कि तेरी आज्ञाओं का पालन करूँ।
hi.B: बिना रुके, जल्दी से, मैं तेरी आज्ञाओं का पालन करने में लग गया।
hi.R: मैं तेरी आज्ञाओं को मानने में जल्दी करता हूँ। मैं देर नहीं करता।

ru.L: Я поспешил и не медлил хранить {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} заповеди.
ru.B: Быстро, без промедления, я взялся соблюдать {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} заповеди.
ru.R: Я спешу исполнять {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} заповеди. Я не жду.

uk.L: Я поспішав і не зволікав берегти {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} заповіді.
uk.B: Швидко, без вагань, я взявся берегти {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} заповіді.
uk.R: Я поспішаю слухатися {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} заповідей. Я не чекаю.

decisions.reason: The verb (hitmahmah) is to linger or hold back (Genesis 19:16).

decisions.choice: commands: what God has told his people to do
decisions.reason: As in 119:6.

source.text: חֶבְלֵ֣י רְשָׁעִ֣ים עִוְּדֻ֑נִי תּֽ֝וֹרָתְךָ֗ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] cords of [the] wicked have surrounded me; your instruction I have not forgotten.

en.L: The ropes of the wicked have wrapped around me; {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction I have not forgotten.
en.B: The wicked have tangled me in their ropes, but I have not forgotten {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction.
en.R: Wicked people have tried to trap me, but I have not forgotten {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} teaching.

fr.L: Les cordes des méchants m’ont enlacé ; je n’ai pas oublié {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi.
fr.B: Les méchants m’ont empêtré dans leurs cordes, mais je n’ai pas oublié {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} instruction.
fr.R: Les méchants ont essayé de me prendre au piège, mais je n’ai pas oublié {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} enseignement.

sw.L: Kamba za waovu zimenizunguka; mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} sijayasahau.
sw.B: Waovu wamenitatiza kwa kamba zao, lakini sijayasahau mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Watu waovu wamejaribu kuninasa, lakini sijayasahau mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

es.L: Las cuerdas de los malvados me han envuelto; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción no he olvidado.
es.B: Los malvados me han enredado en sus cuerdas, pero no he olvidado {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción.
es.R: Los malvados han querido atraparme, pero no he olvidado {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} enseñanza.

vi.L: Dây trói của những kẻ ác đã quấn quanh tôi; sự dạy dỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tôi đã không quên.
vi.B: Những kẻ ác đã dùng dây trói quấn lấy tôi, nhưng tôi không quên lời dạy dỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Những kẻ ác đã tìm cách gài bẫy tôi, nhưng tôi không quên lời dạy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 악인들의 줄들이 저를 휘감았으나, 주님의 가르침을 저는 잊지 않았습니다.
ko.B: 악인들이 줄로 저를 얽어맸지만, 저는 주님의 가르침을 잊지 않았습니다.
ko.R: 악한 사람들이 저를 덫에 걸리게 하려 했지만, 저는 주님의 가르침을 잊지 않았습니다.

pt.L: As cordas dos ímpios me envolveram; o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} ensino não esqueci.
pt.B: Os ímpios me enredaram nas suas cordas, mas eu não esqueci o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} ensino.
pt.R: Pessoas más tentaram me pegar numa armadilha, mas eu não esqueci os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} ensinamentos.

am.L: የክፉዎች ገመዶች ከበቡኝ፤ ሕግህን አልረሳሁም።
am.B: ክፉዎች በገመዳቸው ተበተቡኝ፤ እኔ ግን ሕግህን አልረሳሁም።
am.R: ክፉ ሰዎች ሊያጠምዱኝ ሞከሩ፤ እኔ ግን ሕግህን አልረሳሁም።

hi.L: दुष्टों की रस्सियों ने मुझे लपेट लिया है; तेरी व्यवस्था को मैं नहीं भूला।
hi.B: दुष्टों ने मुझे अपनी रस्सियों में उलझा लिया है, पर मैं तेरी व्यवस्था को नहीं भूला।
hi.R: दुष्ट लोगों ने मुझे फँसाने की कोशिश की है, पर मैं तेरी शिक्षा को नहीं भूला।

ru.L: Верёвки нечестивых опутали меня; {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} Закона я не забыл.
ru.B: Нечестивые запутали меня в свои верёвки, но я не забыл {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} Закона.
ru.R: Злые люди пытались поймать меня в ловушку, но я не забыл {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} наставления.

uk.L: Пута нечестивих обвилися навколо мене; {{deity_pronoun:твоєї|Твоєї}} настанови я не забув.
uk.B: Нечестиві заплутали мене своїми мотузками, але я не забув {{deity_pronoun:твоєї|Твоєї}} настанови.
uk.R: Злі люди намагалися заманити мене в пастку, але я не забув {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} навчання.

decisions.reason: The word (chevel) is a rope, often of a hunter's snare (18:6; 140:6). It can also mean a band of people.
The verb ('iwwed) is rare; it seems to mean to surround or bind round.
As in 119:1.

alternatives: the ropes of the wicked have wrapped around me
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture of the snare means.

source.text: חֲצֽוֹת־לַ֗יְלָה אָ֭קוּם לְהוֹד֣וֹת לָ֑ךְ עַ֝֗ל מִשְׁפְּטֵ֥י צִדְקֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: [At the] middle of [the] night I rise to give thanks to you for [the] judgments of your righteousness.

en.L: At the middle of the night I rise to give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for the judgments of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteousness.
en.B: In the middle of the night I get up to thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} righteous rulings.
en.R: In the middle of the night I get up to thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, because {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} decisions are right.

fr.L: Au milieu de la nuit je me lève pour {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rendre grâce à cause des jugements de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} justice.
fr.B: Au milieu de la nuit je me lève pour {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercier de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} justes décisions.
fr.R: Au milieu de la nuit, je me lève pour {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercier, parce que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décisions sont justes.

sw.L: Katikati ya usiku ninaamka kukushukuru kwa hukumu za haki {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Usiku wa manane ninaamka kukushukuru kwa hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} za haki.
sw.R: Usiku wa manane ninaamka kukushukuru, kwa sababu hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} ni za haki.

es.L: A la mitad de la noche me levanto para darte gracias por los juicios de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} justicia.
es.B: A medianoche me levanto para darte gracias por {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} justos dictámenes.
es.R: A medianoche me levanto para darte gracias, porque {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} decisiones son justas.

vi.L: Lúc nửa đêm tôi thức dậy để cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vì các phán quyết [theo] sự công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Giữa đêm khuya tôi thức dậy để cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vì các phán quyết công chính của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Giữa đêm tôi thức dậy để cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì những quyết định của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đều đúng.

ko.L: 한밤중에 제가 일어나 주님의 의의 판결들로 인하여 주님께 감사합니다.
ko.B: 한밤중에 저는 일어나 주님의 의로운 판결에 감사드립니다.
ko.R: 주님의 결정은 옳기에, 저는 한밤중에도 일어나 주님께 감사드립니다.

pt.L: À meia-noite me levanto para {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} dar graças pelos juízos da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} justiça.
pt.B: No meio da noite eu me levanto para {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} agradecer pelas {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} ordenanças justas.
pt.R: No meio da noite eu me levanto para agradecer a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, porque as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} decisões são certas.

am.L: ስለ ጽድቅህ ፍርዶች አንተን ለማመስገን በእኩለ ሌሊት እነሣለሁ።
am.B: ስለ ጽድቅ ፍርዶችህ ላመሰግንህ በእኩለ ሌሊት እነሣለሁ።
am.R: ፍርዶችህ ትክክል ስለሆኑ ላመሰግንህ በእኩለ ሌሊት እነሣለሁ።

hi.L: आधी रात को मैं तेरे धर्म के नियमों के कारण तेरा धन्यवाद करने को उठता हूँ।
hi.B: आधी रात को मैं उठकर तेरे धर्ममय नियमों के लिए तेरा धन्यवाद करता हूँ।
hi.R: आधी रात को मैं उठकर तेरा धन्यवाद करता हूँ, क्योंकि तेरे फ़ैसले सही हैं।

ru.L: В полночь я встаю благодарить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} за правила {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} праведности.
ru.B: Среди ночи я встаю, чтобы благодарить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} за {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} праведные правила.
ru.R: Посреди ночи я встаю, чтобы благодарить {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, потому что {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} решения правильны.

uk.L: Опівночі я встаю, щоб дякувати {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} за присуди {{deity_pronoun:твоєї|Твоєї}} праведності.
uk.B: Посеред ночі я встаю, щоб подякувати {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} за {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} праведні присуди.
uk.R: Посеред ночі я встаю, щоб подякувати {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}}, бо {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} рішення правильні.

decisions.reason: As in 119:7.

decisions.choice: judgments: God's rulings, his decisions about what is right
decisions.reason: As in 119:7.
As in 119:7.

source.text: חָבֵ֣ר אָ֭נִי לְכָל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְרֵא֑וּךָ וּ֝לְשֹׁמְרֵ֗י פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: A companion I [am] of all who fear you, and of those keeping your precepts.

en.L: A companion I [am] of all who fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and of those who keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.B: I stand with all who fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, with everyone who holds to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.R: I am a friend of everyone who honors {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} and obeys {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instructions.

fr.L: Je [suis] le compagnon de tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craignent, et de ceux qui gardent {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.B: Je suis du côté de tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craignent, de tous ceux qui s’attachent à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.R: Je suis l’ami de tous ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}honorent et qui obéissent à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} consignes.

sw.L: Mwenzi mimi [ni] wa wote wanaokucha, na wa wale wanaoshika maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Ninasimama pamoja na wote wanaokucha, pamoja na kila mtu anayeshikamana na maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Mimi ni rafiki wa kila mtu anayekuheshimu na kuyatii maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

es.L: Compañero [soy] yo de todos los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temen, y de los que guardan {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} preceptos.
es.B: Estoy del lado de todos los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temen, de todos los que se mantienen fieles a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} preceptos.
es.R: Soy amigo de todos los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} honran y obedecen {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} instrucciones.

vi.L: Tôi [là] bạn của mọi người kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và của những người giữ các huấn lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Tôi đứng chung với mọi người kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, với tất cả những ai giữ vững các huấn lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Tôi là bạn của mọi người tôn kính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và vâng theo những lời chỉ dẫn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 저는 주님을 경외하는 모든 자들과 주님의 법도들을 지키는 자들의 벗입니다.
ko.B: 저는 주님을 경외하는 모든 사람, 주님의 법도를 굳게 지키는 모든 사람과 함께합니다.
ko.R: 저는 주님을 두려운 마음으로 섬기고 주님의 지시를 따르는 모든 사람의 친구입니다.

pt.L: Companheiro eu [sou] de todos os que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temem e dos que guardam os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} preceitos.
pt.B: Estou ao lado de todos os que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temem, de todos os que se apegam aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} preceitos.
pt.R: Sou amigo de todos os que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} honram e obedecem às {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} instruções.

am.L: እኔ አንተን ለሚፈሩ ሁሉ፣ መመሪያዎችህንም ለሚጠብቁ ባልንጀራ [ነኝ]።
am.B: አንተን ከሚፈሩ ሁሉ፣ መመሪያዎችህንም ከሚጠብቁ ሁሉ ጋር እቆማለሁ።
am.R: አንተን በአክብሮት የሚፈሩትንና መመሪያዎችህን የሚጠብቁትን ሁሉ ወዳጅ ነኝ።

hi.L: मैं उन सब का साथी [हूँ] जो तेरा भय मानते हैं, और उनका जो तेरे आदेशों का पालन करते हैं।
hi.B: मैं उन सब के साथ खड़ा हूँ जो तेरा भय मानते हैं, हर उस व्यक्ति के साथ जो तेरे आदेशों को थामे रहता है।
hi.R: मैं हर उस व्यक्ति का मित्र हूँ जो तेरा आदर और भय मानता है और तेरे निर्देशों का पालन करता है।

ru.L: Товарищ я всем, кто боится {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, и хранящим {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} наказы.
ru.B: Я заодно со всеми, кто боится {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, со всеми, кто держится {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} наказов.
ru.R: Я друг всем, кто благоговеет перед {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}} и исполняет {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} указания.

uk.L: Товариш я всім, хто боїться {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, і тим, хто береже {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} накази.
uk.B: Я поруч з усіма, хто боїться {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, з кожним, хто тримається {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} наказів.
uk.R: Я друг кожному, хто шанує {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} і слухається {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} вказівок.

decisions.choice: companion: one who is joined to others
decisions.reason: The word (chaver) is a companion or partner, someone bound to others in a shared life.
To fear God is to honor him with awe and to obey him (34:10).

decisions.choice: precepts: the charges God has laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:4.
Readable says "honor", since "fear" alone can sound like terror (m2).

decisions.choice: "주님을 두려운 마음으로 섬기는" (honoring you with awe) at Readable for those who fear God; "경외하는" (L, B), throughout the psalm
decisions.reason: As the terms note for the fear of the LORD: "무서워하다" alone would sound like terror (meaning decision m2).

source.text: חַסְדְּךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה מָלְאָ֥ה הָאָ֗רֶץ חֻקֶּ֥יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: [Of] your loyal love, YHWH, is full the earth; teach me your statutes.

en.L: [With] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, the earth is full; teach me {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love fills all the earth; teach me {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love is everywhere on earth. Teach me {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} laws.

fr.L: [De] {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, la terre est pleine ; enseigne-moi {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle remplit toute la terre ; enseigne-moi {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle est partout sur la terre. Enseigne-moi {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lois.

sw.L: [Kwa] upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, dunia imejaa; unifundishe kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma unaijaza dunia yote; unifundishe kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma uko kila mahali duniani. Unifundishe kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

es.L: [De] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, está llena la tierra; enséñame {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} estatutos.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel llena toda la tierra; enséñame {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} estatutos.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel está por todas partes en la tierra. Enséñame {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} leyes.

vi.L: Tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tràn đầy khắp đất; xin dạy tôi các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tràn ngập khắp đất; xin dạy tôi các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} có ở khắp nơi trên đất. Xin dạy tôi luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 주님의 한결같은 사랑으로, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 땅이 가득합니다. 주님의 규례들을 저에게 가르쳐 주십시오.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 한결같은 사랑이 온 땅에 가득합니다. 주님의 규례를 저에게 가르쳐 주십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 변함없는 사랑이 온 세상 어디에나 있습니다. 주님의 법을 저에게 가르쳐 주십시오.

pt.L: [Do] {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, a terra está cheia; ensina-me os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} estatutos.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal enche a terra inteira; ensina-me os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} estatutos.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor fiel está em toda parte na terra. Ensina-me as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} leis.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ምድር በጽኑ ፍቅርህ ተሞልታለች፤ ሥርዓቶችህን አስተምረኝ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ጽኑ ፍቅርህ ምድርን ሁሉ ሞልቷል፤ ሥርዓቶችህን አስተምረኝ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ጽኑ ፍቅርህ በምድር ሁሉ አለ። ሥርዓቶችህን አስተምረኝ።

hi.L: तेरे अटल प्रेम से, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, पृथ्वी भरी है; मुझे अपनी विधियाँ सिखा।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तेरा अटल प्रेम सारी पृथ्वी में भरा है; मुझे अपनी विधियाँ सिखा।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तेरा अटल प्रेम पृथ्वी पर हर जगह है। मुझे अपनी विधियाँ सिखा।

ru.L: Твоей неизменной любовью, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, полна земля; научи меня {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} установлениям.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} неизменная любовь наполняет всю землю; научи меня {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} установлениям.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} неизменная любовь повсюду на земле. Научи меня {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} законам.

uk.L: Твоєю незмінною любовʼю, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, повна земля; навчи мене {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} постанов.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} незмінна любов наповнює всю землю; навчи мене {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} постанов.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} вірна любов — усюди на землі. Навчи мене {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} законів.

decisions.choice: the earth is full of his loyal love
decisions.reason: Psalm 33:5 says the same. The stanza ends where it began, with the LORD who fills all things and is the psalmist's portion.

decisions.choice: statutes: rules that are fixed and laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:5.
As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

records.literal_gloss: Good you have done with your servant, YHWH, according to your word.

en.L: Good {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have done with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, according to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have treated {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant well, just as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word said.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have been good to me, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, just as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word said.

fr.L: Tu as fait du bien à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, selon {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as bien traité {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, comme {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole l’avait dit.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as été bon pour moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur, comme {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole l’avait dit.

sw.L: Mema umemtendea mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kulingana na neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, umemtendea mema mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, kama neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} lilivyosema.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, umekuwa mwema kwangu mimi mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}, kama neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} lilivyosema.

es.L: Bien has hecho con {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, conforme a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has tratado bien a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, tal como dijo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has sido bueno conmigo, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo, tal como dijo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra.

vi.L: Điều tốt lành {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, theo lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đối xử tốt với đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đúng như lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tốt với tôi, là đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, đúng như lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nói.

ko.L: 선을 주님께서 주님의 종에게 행하셨습니다, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 말씀대로.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서는 주님의 말씀대로 주님의 종을 잘 대해 주셨습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님께서는 말씀하신 대로 주님의 종인 저에게 잘해 주셨습니다.

pt.L: Bem {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, conforme a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} trataste bem o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo, como a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra disse.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} foste bom para mim, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo, como a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra disse.

am.L: ከባሪያህ ጋር መልካም አደረግህ፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ እንደ ቃልህ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ቃልህ እንደተናገረው አገልጋይህን በመልካም ያዝኸው።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ቃልህ እንደተናገረው ለእኔ ለአገልጋይህ መልካም ሆንክልኝ።

hi.L: तूने अपने दास के साथ भलाई की है, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, अपने वचन के अनुसार।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तूने अपने दास के साथ भला व्यवहार किया है, जैसा तेरे वचन ने कहा था।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तू मेरे साथ, अपने दास के साथ, भला रहा है, जैसा तेरे वचन ने कहा था।

ru.L: Благо {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сделал {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} рабу, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, по {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} слову.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} хорошо обошёлся с {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} рабом, как и сказало {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} слово.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} был добр ко мне, {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} рабу, как и говорило {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} слово.

uk.L: Добро {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вчинив {{deity_pronoun:твоєму|Твоєму}} рабові, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, за {{deity_pronoun:твоїм|Твоїм}} словом.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} добре повівся з {{deity_pronoun:твоїм|Твоїм}} рабом, як і сказало {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} слово.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} був добрим до мене, {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} раба, як і сказало {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} слово.

decisions.reason: Each of the eight verses of this stanza begins with the letter teth, the ninth letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see 119:1). Five of them (verses 65, 66, 68, 71, 72) begin with the word "good" (tov), the theme of the stanza.
As in 119:9.

source.text: ט֤וּב טַ֣עַם וָדַ֣עַת לַמְּדֵ֑נִי כִּ֖י בְמִצְוֺתֶ֣יךָ הֶאֱמָֽנְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: Goodness of discernment and knowledge teach me, for in your commands I have believed.

en.L: Good discernment and knowledge teach me, for in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands I have trusted.
en.B: Train me in good sense and knowledge, for I rely on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.
en.R: Teach me to know what is right and to make wise choices, because I trust {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.

fr.L: Enseigne-moi le bon discernement et la connaissance, car j’ai eu confiance en {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.B: Forme-moi au bon sens et à la connaissance, car je compte sur {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.R: Apprends-moi à savoir ce qui est bien et à faire des choix sages, parce que j’ai confiance en {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.

sw.L: Busara njema na maarifa unifundishe, kwa maana katika amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} nimeamini.
sw.B: Unifundishe akili njema na maarifa, kwa maana ninazitegemea amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Unifundishe kujua lililo sawa na kufanya maamuzi ya hekima, kwa sababu ninaziamini amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

es.L: Buen discernimiento y conocimiento enséñame, porque en {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos he creído.
es.B: Instrúyeme en el buen sentido y el conocimiento, porque me apoyo en {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos.
es.R: Enséñame a reconocer lo que es correcto y a escoger con sabiduría, porque confío en {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos.

vi.L: Sự phán đoán tốt và tri thức, xin dạy tôi, vì tôi đã tin cậy các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Xin rèn luyện tôi trong sự suy xét đúng đắn và hiểu biết, vì tôi nương cậy các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Xin dạy tôi biết điều gì là đúng và biết chọn lựa khôn ngoan, vì tôi tin cậy các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 좋은 분별력과 지식을 저에게 가르쳐 주십시오, 제가 주님의 계명들을 믿었기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 바른 판단력과 지식을 저에게 길러 주십시오. 저는 주님의 계명을 의지합니다.
ko.R: 무엇이 옳은지 알고 지혜롭게 선택하도록 저를 가르쳐 주십시오. 저는 주님의 명령을 믿습니다.

pt.L: Bom discernimento e conhecimento ensina-me, pois nos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} mandamentos confiei.
pt.B: Ensina-me o bom senso e o conhecimento, pois eu me apoio nos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} mandamentos.
pt.R: Ensina-me a saber o que é certo e a fazer escolhas sábias, porque eu confio nos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} mandamentos.

am.L: መልካም ማስተዋልንና እውቀትን አስተምረኝ፤ በትእዛዛትህ አምኛለሁና።
am.B: ትእዛዛትህን ስለምተማመን በበጎ ማስተዋልና በእውቀት አሰልጥነኝ።
am.R: በትእዛዛትህ ስለምታመን ትክክል የሆነውን እንዳውቅና ጥበብ ያለበትን ምርጫ እንዳደርግ አስተምረኝ።

hi.L: मुझे अच्छी विवेक-बुद्धि और ज्ञान सिखा, क्योंकि मैंने तेरी आज्ञाओं पर भरोसा किया है।
hi.B: मुझे अच्छी समझ और ज्ञान में निपुण कर, क्योंकि मैं तेरी आज्ञाओं पर भरोसा रखता हूँ।
hi.R: मुझे सिखा कि मैं जानूँ कि क्या सही है और बुद्धिमानी से चुनाव करूँ, क्योंकि मुझे तेरी आज्ञाओं पर भरोसा है।

ru.L: Доброму разумению и знанию научи меня, потому что {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} заповедям я поверил.
ru.B: Научи меня здравому смыслу и знанию, ведь я полагаюсь на {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} заповеди.
ru.R: Научи меня понимать, что правильно, и делать мудрый выбор, потому что я доверяю {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} заповедям.

uk.L: Доброго розсуду й знання навчи мене, бо в {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} заповіді я повірив.
uk.B: Навчи мене здорового глузду й знання, бо я покладаюся на {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} заповіді.
uk.R: Навчи мене знати, що правильно, і робити мудрий вибір, бо я довіряю {{deity_pronoun:твоїм|Твоїм}} заповідям.

decisions.reason: The word (ta'am) is taste, and so the ability to tell good from bad (1 Samuel 25:33).
The verb (he'emin) is to hold something as firm and reliable and to lean on it.

decisions.choice: commands: what God has told his people to do
decisions.reason: As in 119:6.

source.text: טֶ֣רֶם אֶ֭עֱנֶה אֲנִ֣י שֹׁגֵ֑ג וְ֝עַתָּ֗ה אִמְרָתְךָ֥ שָׁמָֽרְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: Before I was afflicted I was going astray, and now your saying I keep.

en.L: Before I was afflicted I was going astray, but now {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} saying I keep.
en.B: Until I was brought low, I kept wandering off; but now I hold to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.
en.R: Before I suffered, I wandered away from {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. But now I obey what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} said.

fr.L: Avant d’être affligé, je m’égarais, mais maintenant je garde {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} propos.
fr.B: Jusqu’à ce que je sois humilié, je m’écartais sans cesse ; mais maintenant je m’attache à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.
fr.R: Avant de souffrir, je m’éloignais de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. Mais maintenant, j’obéis à ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as dit.

sw.L: Kabla sijateswa nilikuwa nikipotea, lakini sasa kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ninaishika.
sw.B: Mpaka niliposhushwa chini, niliendelea kupotea; lakini sasa ninaishika kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Kabla sijateseka, nilipotea mbali na {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}. Lakini sasa ninaitii kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

es.L: Antes de sufrir aflicción, me descarriaba, pero ahora {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dicho guardo.
es.B: Hasta que la aflicción me abatió, me iba desviando; pero ahora me mantengo fiel a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra.
es.R: Antes de sufrir, me alejaba de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Pero ahora obedezco lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} dijiste.

vi.L: Trước khi bị khốn khổ, tôi đã lầm lạc, nhưng bây giờ lời phán của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tôi gìn giữ.
vi.B: Trước khi bị hạ xuống, tôi cứ đi lạc; nhưng bây giờ tôi giữ vững lời phán của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Trước khi chịu khổ, tôi đã đi lạc xa {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Nhưng bây giờ tôi vâng theo điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán.

ko.L: 고난을 당하기 전에는 제가 그릇 갔으나, 이제는 주님께서 하신 말씀을 지킵니다.
ko.B: 낮아지기 전까지 저는 자꾸 길을 벗어났지만, 이제는 주님의 말씀을 굳게 지킵니다.
ko.R: 고난을 겪기 전에는 제가 주님을 떠나 헤맸습니다. 그러나 이제는 주님께서 하신 말씀을 따릅니다.

pt.L: Antes de ser afligido eu andava errante, mas agora o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} dito guardo.
pt.B: Até eu ser abatido, eu vivia me desviando; mas agora me apego à {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra.
pt.R: Antes de sofrer, eu me afastei de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}. Mas agora obedeço ao que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} disseste.

am.L: መከራ ከመቀበሌ በፊት እስት ነበር፤ አሁን ግን ንግግርህን እጠብቃለሁ።
am.B: ዝቅ ከመደረጌ በፊት እባዝን ነበር፤ አሁን ግን ተስፋ ቃልህን እጠብቃለሁ።
am.R: መከራ ከመድረሱ በፊት ከአንተ ርቄ እባዝን ነበር። አሁን ግን ተስፋ ቃልህን እጠብቃለሁ።

hi.L: दुःख उठाने से पहले मैं भटकता था, पर अब मैं तेरे कथन का पालन करता हूँ।
hi.B: जब तक मैं दबाया नहीं गया, मैं भटकता रहा; पर अब मैं तेरे वचन को थामे रहता हूँ।
hi.R: दुःख उठाने से पहले मैं तुझसे दूर भटक गया था। पर अब मैं वही मानता हूँ जो तूने कहा है।

ru.L: Прежде чем я был угнетён, я блуждал, но теперь {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} речение храню.
ru.B: Пока меня не смирили, я всё сбивался с пути; но теперь я держусь {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} слова.
ru.R: Пока я не пострадал, я уходил от {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}. Но теперь я исполняю то, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} сказал.

uk.L: Перш ніж я був упокорений, я блукав, а тепер {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} вислів я бережу.
uk.B: Доки мене не впокорено, я все збивався з дороги; а тепер я тримаюся {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} слова.
uk.R: Поки я не страждав, я блукав далеко від {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}. А тепер я слухаюся того, що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} сказав.

decisions.reason: The verb ('anah) is to be bowed down by hardship. Verses 71 and 75 say that God used it to teach the psalmist.

decisions.choice: going astray: straying, often without knowing
decisions.reason: The verb (shagag) is used of wrong done by mistake (Leviticus 4:2).

decisions.choice: saying: what God has said, often his promise

decisions.reason: No promise is in view here, so Balanced says "word" and Readable "what you said" (see 119:11).
Readable says from whom the psalmist wandered.
No promise is in view here, so Balanced says "слово" and Readable "то, что ты сказал", as the English (see 119:11).

records.literal_gloss: Good [are] you, and doing good; teach me your statutes.

en.L: Good [are] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and doing good; teach me {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes.
en.B: You are good, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} bring about good; teach me {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes.
en.R: You are good, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do good things. Teach me {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} laws.

fr.L: [Tu es] bon et faisant le bien ; enseigne-moi {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions.
fr.B: Tu es bon, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais le bien ; enseigne-moi {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions.
fr.R: Tu es bon, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fais de bonnes choses. Enseigne-moi {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lois.

sw.L: Mwema [ni] {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, na mtenda mema; unifundishe kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Wewe ni mwema, na unatenda mema; unifundishe kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Wewe ni mwema, na unatenda mambo mema. Unifundishe kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

es.L: Bueno [eres] {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}, y haces el bien; enséñame {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} estatutos.
es.B: Tú eres bueno, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} haces el bien; enséñame {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} estatutos.
es.R: Tú eres bueno, y haces cosas buenas. Enséñame {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} leyes.

vi.L: Ngài [là] tốt lành, và làm điều tốt lành; xin dạy tôi các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Ngài là Đấng tốt lành, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm ra điều tốt lành; xin dạy tôi các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ngài thật tốt, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm những điều tốt. Xin dạy tôi luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 주님은 선하시고 선을 행하십니다. 주님의 규례들을 저에게 가르쳐 주십시오.
ko.B: 주님은 선하시고, 선한 일을 이루십니다. 주님의 규례를 저에게 가르쳐 주십시오.
ko.R: 주님은 좋으신 분이시고, 좋은 일을 하십니다. 주님의 법을 저에게 가르쳐 주십시오.

pt.L: Bom [és] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}, e fazes o bem; ensina-me os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} estatutos.
pt.B: Tu és bom e fazes o bem; ensina-me os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} estatutos.
pt.R: Tu és bom e fazes coisas boas. Ensina-me as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} leis.

am.L: አንተ መልካም [ነህ]፣ መልካምም የምታደርግ፤ ሥርዓቶችህን አስተምረኝ።
am.B: አንተ መልካም ነህ፤ መልካምንም ታደርጋለህ፤ ሥርዓቶችህን አስተምረኝ።
am.R: አንተ መልካም ነህ፤ መልካም ነገሮችንም ታደርጋለህ። ሥርዓቶችህን አስተምረኝ።

hi.L: तू भला [है], और भलाई करनेवाला; मुझे अपनी विधियाँ सिखा।
hi.B: तू भला है, और तू भलाई करता है; मुझे अपनी विधियाँ सिखा।
hi.R: तू भला है, और तू भले काम करता है। मुझे अपनी विधियाँ सिखा।

ru.L: Благ {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} и творишь благо; научи меня {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} установлениям.
ru.B: Ты добр и творишь добро; научи меня {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} установлениям.
ru.R: Ты добрый, и {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} делаешь доброе. Научи меня {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} законам.

uk.L: Добрий {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}}, і чиниш добро; навчи мене {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} постанов.
uk.B: Ти добрий, і {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} твориш добро; навчи мене {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} постанов.
uk.R: Ти добрий, і {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} робиш добрі справи. Навчи мене {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} законів.

decisions.choice: doing good: what God always does
decisions.reason: The participle describes what God does by nature: he is good and he does good.

decisions.choice: statutes: rules that are fixed and laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:5.

source.text: טָפְל֬וּ עָלַ֣י שֶׁ֣קֶר זֵדִ֑ים אֲ֝נִ֗י בְּכָל־לֵ֤ב׀אֱצֹּ֬ר פִּקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] arrogant have smeared on me falsehood; I with all [the] heart keep your precepts.

en.L: The arrogant have smeared lies on me; I, with all [the] heart, keep {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.B: The proud have plastered lies all over me, but with my whole heart I hold to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.R: Proud people tell lies to ruin my good name, but I obey {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instructions with all my heart.

fr.L: Les orgueilleux ont plaqué sur moi le mensonge ; moi, de tout cœur, je garde {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.B: Les orgueilleux m’ont couvert de mensonges, mais de tout mon cœur je m’attache à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.R: Les orgueilleux disent des mensonges pour salir ma réputation, mais j’obéis à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} consignes de tout mon cœur.

sw.L: Wenye kiburi wamenipaka uongo; mimi kwa moyo wote nayashika maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Wenye kiburi wamenipaka uongo kila mahali, lakini kwa moyo wangu wote ninashikamana na maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Watu wenye kiburi husema uongo ili kuliharibu jina langu jema, lakini mimi ninayatii maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kwa moyo wangu wote.

es.L: Los soberbios me han untado de mentira; yo, con todo [el] corazón, guardo {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} preceptos.
es.B: Los orgullosos me han cubierto de mentiras, pero con todo mi corazón me mantengo fiel a {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} preceptos.
es.R: Los orgullosos dicen mentiras para arruinar mi buen nombre, pero yo obedezco {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} instrucciones con todo mi corazón.

vi.L: Những kẻ kiêu ngạo đã bôi điều dối trá lên tôi; [còn] tôi, với trọn lòng, giữ các huấn lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Những kẻ kiêu căng đã trát đầy lời dối trá lên tôi, nhưng tôi hết lòng giữ vững các huấn lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Những kẻ kiêu ngạo nói dối để bôi nhọ thanh danh tôi, nhưng tôi hết lòng vâng theo những lời chỉ dẫn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 교만한 자들이 거짓을 저에게 덧칠하였으나, 저는 온 마음으로 주님의 법도들을 지킵니다.
ko.B: 교만한 자들이 거짓말로 저를 온통 더럽혔지만, 저는 온 마음으로 주님의 법도를 굳게 지킵니다.
ko.R: 교만한 사람들이 거짓말로 제 이름을 더럽히지만, 저는 온 마음으로 주님의 지시를 따릅니다.

pt.L: Os arrogantes me emplastraram de mentira; eu, de todo [o] coração, guardo os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} preceitos.
pt.B: Os orgulhosos me cobriram de mentiras, mas eu me apego de todo o coração aos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} preceitos.
pt.R: Pessoas orgulhosas contam mentiras para acabar com o meu bom nome, mas eu obedeço às {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} instruções com todo o meu coração.

am.L: ትዕቢተኞች ሐሰትን በላዬ ለጠፉ፤ እኔ በሙሉ ልብ መመሪያዎችህን አከብራለሁ።
am.B: ትዕቢተኞች ውሸትን በላዬ ቀቡ፤ እኔ ግን በሙሉ ልቤ መመሪያዎችህን አከብራለሁ።
am.R: ትዕቢተኞች መልካም ስሜን ለማጥፋት ይዋሻሉ፤ እኔ ግን በሙሉ ልቤ መመሪያዎችህን አከብራለሁ።

hi.L: अभिमानियों ने मुझ पर झूठ पोता है; मैं पूरे मन से तेरे आदेशों का पालन करता हूँ।
hi.B: अभिमानियों ने मुझ पर झूठ ही झूठ थोप दिया है, पर मैं पूरे मन से तेरे आदेशों को थामे रहता हूँ।
hi.R: घमंडी लोग मेरा नाम बिगाड़ने के लिए झूठ बोलते हैं, पर मैं पूरे मन से तेरे निर्देशों का पालन करता हूँ।

ru.L: Надменные обмазали меня ложью; я всем сердцем храню {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} наказы.
ru.B: Гордые облепили меня ложью, но я всем сердцем держусь {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} наказов.
ru.R: Гордые люди лгут, чтобы погубить моё доброе имя, но я всем сердцем исполняю {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} указания.

uk.L: Зарозумілі обмазали мене брехнею; я всім серцем бережу {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} накази.
uk.B: Горді обліпили мене брехнею, а я всім серцем тримаюся {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} наказів.
uk.R: Горді люди брешуть, щоб зіпсувати моє добре імʼя, але я всім серцем слухаюся {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} вказівок.

decisions.choice: smeared lies on me: covered me with lies
decisions.reason: The verb (tafal) is to smear or plaster over (Job 13:4). Lies are spread over the psalmist to hide who he really is.

decisions.choice: precepts: the charges God has laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:4.

decisions.choice: tell lies to ruin my good name
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means.

source.text: טָפַ֣שׁ כַּחֵ֣לֶב לִבָּ֑ם אֲ֝נִ֗י תּוֹרָתְךָ֥ שִֽׁעֲשָֽׁעְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: Their heart is unfeeling like fat; I, your instruction I delight in.

en.L: Their heart is gross like fat; as for me, I delight in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction.
en.B: Their hearts are thick and dull as fat, but I delight in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction.
en.R: Their hearts feel nothing, like a lump of fat. But {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} teaching makes me glad.

fr.L: Leur cœur est épais comme la graisse ; moi, je trouve mes délices dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi.
fr.B: Leur cœur est lourd et insensible comme la graisse, mais moi, je fais mes délices de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} instruction.
fr.R: Leur cœur ne ressent rien, comme un morceau de graisse. Mais {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} enseignement me rend heureux.

sw.L: Moyo wao umenenepa kama mafuta; mimi, mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ninayafurahia.
sw.B: Mioyo yao ni mizito na butu kama mafuta, lakini mimi ninafurahia mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Mioyo yao haihisi kitu, kama donge la mafuta. Lakini mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yananifurahisha.

es.L: Su corazón es insensible como la grasa; en cuanto a mí, me deleito en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción.
es.B: Sus corazones son gruesos y torpes como la grasa, pero yo me deleito en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción.
es.R: Sus corazones no sienten nada, como un trozo de grasa. Pero {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} enseñanza me alegra.

vi.L: Lòng chúng đặc lại như mỡ; còn tôi, tôi vui thích trong sự dạy dỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Lòng chúng dày và trơ lì như mỡ, nhưng tôi vui thích trong lời dạy dỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Lòng chúng chẳng cảm biết gì, như một tảng mỡ. Nhưng lời dạy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm tôi vui.

ko.L: 그들의 마음은 기름처럼 무디지만, 저는 주님의 가르침을 즐거워합니다.
ko.B: 그들의 마음은 기름처럼 두껍고 둔하지만, 저는 주님의 가르침을 기뻐합니다.
ko.R: 그들의 마음은 기름 덩어리처럼 아무것도 느끼지 못합니다. 그러나 주님의 가르침은 저를 기쁘게 합니다.

pt.L: O coração deles é insensível como gordura; eu, no {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} ensino me deleito.
pt.B: O coração deles é grosso e embotado como gordura, mas eu me deleito no {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} ensino.
pt.R: O coração deles não sente nada, como um pedaço de gordura. Mas os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} ensinamentos me deixam alegre.

am.L: ልባቸው እንደ ስብ ደንዳና ነው፤ እኔ ግን በሕግህ ደስ ይለኛል።
am.B: ልባቸው እንደ ስብ ወፍራምና የደነዘዘ ነው፤ እኔ ግን በሕግህ ደስ እሰኛለሁ።
am.R: ልባቸው እንደ አንድ ቁራጭ ስብ ምንም አይሰማውም። ሕግህ ግን ደስ ያሰኘኛል።

hi.L: उनका हृदय चर्बी के समान जड़ है; पर मैं तेरी व्यवस्था से प्रसन्न रहता हूँ।
hi.B: उनके हृदय चर्बी जैसे मोटे और सुन्न हैं, पर मैं तेरी व्यवस्था से प्रसन्न रहता हूँ।
hi.R: उनके दिल चर्बी के लोंदे जैसे हैं, उन्हें कुछ महसूस नहीं होता। पर तेरी शिक्षा से मुझे ख़ुशी मिलती है।

ru.L: Отупело, как жир, их сердце; я же {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} Законом наслаждаюсь.
ru.B: Их сердца толсты и тупы, как жир, а я нахожу радость в {{deity_pronoun:твоём|Твоём}} Законе.
ru.R: Их сердца ничего не чувствуют, как кусок жира. А меня радует {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} наставление.

uk.L: Їхнє серце огрубіло, як жир; а я втішаюся {{deity_pronoun:твоєю|Твоєю}} настановою.
uk.B: Їхні серця товсті й тупі, як жир, а я тішуся {{deity_pronoun:твоєю|Твоєю}} настановою.
uk.R: Їхні серця нічого не відчувають, як шматок жиру. А мене тішить {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} навчання.

decisions.choice: unfeeling like fat: dull, closed to God
decisions.reason: A heart covered in fat cannot feel or understand (Isaiah 6:10). The arrogant are set against the psalmist, who delights in God's instruction.
As in 119:1.

records.literal_gloss: [It was] good for me that I was afflicted, so that I might learn your statutes.

en.L: It [was] good for me that I was afflicted, so that I might learn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes.
en.B: It did me good to be brought low, so that I would learn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes.
en.R: Suffering was good for me, so that I could learn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} laws.

fr.L: [Il était] bon pour moi que j’aie été affligé, afin que j’apprenne {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions.
fr.B: Il m’a été bon d’être humilié, pour que j’apprenne {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions.
fr.R: Souffrir m’a fait du bien, car ainsi j’ai pu apprendre {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lois.

sw.L: [Ilikuwa] vema kwangu kwamba niliteswa, ili nijifunze kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Ilinifaa kushushwa chini, ili nijifunze kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Mateso yalinifaa, ili niweze kujifunza kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

es.L: Bueno [fue] para mí sufrir aflicción, para que aprendiera {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} estatutos.
es.B: Me hizo bien pasar por la humillación, para que aprendiera {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} estatutos.
es.R: El sufrimiento fue bueno para mí, para que pudiera aprender {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} leyes.

vi.L: [Thật] tốt cho tôi vì tôi đã bị khốn khổ, để tôi học các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Việc tôi bị hạ xuống đã đem lại điều tốt cho tôi, để tôi học biết các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Sự đau khổ đã có ích cho tôi, để tôi có thể học biết luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 제가 고난을 당한 것이 저에게 좋았습니다, 제가 주님의 규례들을 배우게 되었으니.
ko.B: 낮아진 것이 저에게는 유익이었습니다. 그로써 주님의 규례를 배우게 되었습니다.
ko.R: 고난을 겪은 것이 저에게는 좋은 일이었습니다. 그래서 주님의 법을 배울 수 있었습니다.

pt.L: Bom [foi] para mim ter sido afligido, para que eu aprendesse os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} estatutos.
pt.B: Ser abatido me fez bem, para que eu aprendesse os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} estatutos.
pt.R: O sofrimento foi bom para mim, para que eu pudesse aprender as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} leis.

am.L: መከራ መቀበሌ መልካም ሆነልኝ፣ ሥርዓቶችህን እማር ዘንድ።
am.B: ሥርዓቶችህን እንድማር ዝቅ መደረጌ ጠቀመኝ።
am.R: ሥርዓቶችህን እንድማር መከራ ለእኔ መልካም ነበር።

hi.L: मेरे लिए भला [हुआ] कि मैं दुःखी किया गया, ताकि मैं तेरी विधियाँ सीखूँ।
hi.B: दबाए जाने से मेरा भला ही हुआ, ताकि मैं तेरी विधियाँ सीख सकूँ।
hi.R: दुःख उठाना मेरे लिए अच्छा रहा, ताकि मैं तेरी विधियाँ सीख सकूँ।

ru.L: Хорошо мне, что я был угнетён, чтобы мне научиться {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} установлениям.
ru.B: Мне пошло на пользу то, что меня смирили: так я научился {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} установлениям.
ru.R: Страдание было мне на пользу, чтобы я мог научиться {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} законам.

uk.L: Добре мені, що я був упокорений, щоб навчитися {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} постанов.
uk.B: Мені пішло на добре, що мене впокорено, щоб я навчився {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} постанов.
uk.R: Страждання пішли мені на добре, щоб я міг навчитися {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} законів.

decisions.reason: The psalmist does not call suffering good in itself, but says God used it to bring him back to his ways (verse 67; Deuteronomy 8:2-3).

decisions.choice: statutes: rules that are fixed and laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:5.

records.literal_gloss: Better to me [is the] instruction of your mouth than thousands of gold and silver.

en.L: Better to me [is] the instruction of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} mouth than thousands of gold and silver.
en.B: The instruction {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken is worth more to me than gold and silver by the thousand.
en.R: What {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} teach me is worth more to me than a fortune in gold and silver.

fr.L: Meilleure pour moi [est] la loi de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bouche que des milliers d’or et d’argent.
fr.B: L’instruction que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as prononcée vaut plus pour moi que l’or et l’argent par milliers.
fr.R: Ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’enseignes a plus de valeur pour moi qu’une fortune en or et en argent.

sw.L: Bora kwangu [ni] mafundisho ya kinywa {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}} kuliko maelfu ya dhahabu na fedha.
sw.B: Mafundisho uliyoyanena yana thamani kwangu kuliko dhahabu na fedha kwa maelfu.
sw.R: Mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yana thamani zaidi kwangu kuliko mali nyingi ya dhahabu na fedha.

es.L: Mejor para mí [es] la instrucción de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} boca que miles de [piezas de] oro y plata.
es.B: La instrucción que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has pronunciado vale más para mí que oro y plata a millares.
es.R: Lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me enseñas vale más para mí que una fortuna en oro y plata.

vi.L: Sự dạy dỗ từ miệng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [thì] tốt cho tôi hơn hàng ngàn [nén] vàng và bạc.
vi.B: Lời dạy dỗ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán ra quý giá cho tôi hơn hàng ngàn lượng vàng bạc.
vi.R: Lời dạy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quý với tôi hơn cả một gia tài bằng vàng bạc.

ko.L: 주님의 입의 가르침이 저에게는 수천의 금과 은보다 좋습니다.
ko.B: 주님께서 말씀하신 가르침이 저에게는 수천 냥의 금과 은보다 더 귀합니다.
ko.R: 주님의 가르침은 저에게 엄청난 금과 은보다 더 값집니다.

pt.L: Melhor para mim [é] o ensino da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} boca do que milhares de ouro e prata.
pt.B: O ensino que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pronunciaste vale mais para mim do que ouro e prata aos milhares.
pt.R: Os ensinamentos que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me dás valem mais para mim do que uma fortuna em ouro e prata.

am.L: ከሺህ ወርቅና ብር ይልቅ የአፍህ ሕግ ለእኔ ይሻላል።
am.B: የተናገርከው ሕግ በሺህ ከሚቆጠር ወርቅና ብር ይልቅ ለእኔ ዋጋው ይበልጣል።
am.R: የአንተ ሕግ ለእኔ ከብዙ ወርቅና ብር ሀብት ይበልጣል።

hi.L: तेरे मुँह की व्यवस्था मेरे लिए हज़ारों [टुकड़े] सोने और चाँदी से उत्तम [है]।
hi.B: तेरी कही हुई व्यवस्था मेरे लिए हज़ारों की गिनती में सोने और चाँदी से भी अधिक मूल्यवान है।
hi.R: तेरी शिक्षा मेरे लिए सोने-चाँदी के बड़े ख़ज़ाने से भी अधिक क़ीमती है।

ru.L: Лучше для меня Закон {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} уст, нежели тысячи [слитков] золота и серебра.
ru.B: Закон, который произнёс {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}, для меня дороже золота и серебра тысячами.
ru.R: Наставление, которое {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} даёшь мне, дороже для меня, чем целое состояние в золоте и серебре.

uk.L: Краща для мене настанова {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} уст, ніж тисячі золота й срібла.
uk.B: Настанова, яку {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} промовив, для мене цінніша за тисячі золотих і срібних монет.
uk.R: Те, чого {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} мене навчаєш, для мене цінніше за ціле багатство в золоті й сріблі.

decisions.reason: Hebrew says "good ... more than" to mean "better than". The stanza's word "good" (tov) opens this verse too.
As in 119:1.

decisions.choice: thousands of gold and silver: great wealth
decisions.reason: The phrase means thousands of pieces (weights) of gold and silver (19:11).
Readable says what the amount means.

decisions.choice: Os ensinamentos que tu me dás
decisions.reason: The English Readable says "What you teach me" here; Portuguese keeps the psalm's Readable word for torah, "os ensinamentos", so that the term reads the same in every verse, and says "que tu me dás" for "of your mouth".

source.text: יָדֶ֣יךָ עָ֭שׂוּנִי וַֽיְכוֹנְנ֑וּנִי הֲ֝בִינֵ֗נִי וְאֶלְמְדָ֥ה מִצְוֺתֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Your hands made me and established me; give me understanding, and I will learn your commands.

en.L: Your hands made me and established me; give me understanding, that I may learn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.
en.B: Your hands made me and shaped me; give me insight, so that I can learn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.
en.R: You made me with {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} own hands and formed me. Help me understand, so that I can learn {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands.
