fr.L: Tes mains m’ont fait et m’ont affermi ; donne-moi l’intelligence, pour que j’apprenne {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.B: Tes mains m’ont fait et m’ont façonné ; donne-moi le discernement, pour que je puisse apprendre {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.
fr.R: Tu m’as fait de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} propres mains et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as formé. Aide-moi à comprendre, pour que je puisse apprendre {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements.

sw.L: Mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ilinifanya na kunithibitisha; unipe ufahamu, ili nijifunze amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ilinifanya na kunitengeneza; unipe ufahamu, ili niweze kujifunza amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Ulinifanya kwa mikono {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}} na kuniumba. Unisaidie kuelewa, ili niweze kujifunza amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

es.L: Tus manos me hicieron y me afirmaron; dame entendimiento, para que aprenda {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos.
es.B: Tus manos me hicieron y me formaron; dame inteligencia, para que pueda aprender {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos.
es.R: Tú me hiciste con {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} propias manos y me formaste. Ayúdame a entender, para que pueda aprender {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos.

vi.L: Tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm nên tôi và lập vững tôi; xin cho tôi sự hiểu biết, để tôi học các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã tạo nên tôi và nắn nên hình tôi; xin cho tôi sự thông sáng, để tôi học biết các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Ngài đã dùng chính tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm nên tôi và tạo hình cho tôi. Xin giúp tôi hiểu, để tôi học biết các điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 주님의 손이 저를 만드시고 저를 세우셨습니다. 저에게 깨달음을 주십시오, 제가 주님의 계명들을 배우도록.
ko.B: 주님의 손이 저를 만드시고 빚으셨습니다. 저에게 깨달음을 주셔서 주님의 계명을 배우게 해 주십시오.
ko.R: 주님께서 손수 저를 만드시고 빚으셨습니다. 제가 깨닫도록 도와주셔서 주님의 명령을 배우게 해 주십시오.

pt.L: As {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} mãos me fizeram e me firmaram; dá-me entendimento, para que eu aprenda os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} mandamentos.
pt.B: Foram as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} mãos que me fizeram e me formaram; dá-me discernimento, para que eu possa aprender os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} mandamentos.
pt.R: Tu me fizeste com as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} próprias mãos e me formaste. Ajuda-me a entender, para que eu aprenda os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} mandamentos.

am.L: እጆችህ ሠሩኝ፣ አጸኑኝም፤ ትእዛዛትህን እማር ዘንድ ማስተዋልን ስጠኝ።
am.B: እጆችህ ሠሩኝ፤ ቀረጹኝም፤ ትእዛዛትህን እንድማር ማስተዋልን ስጠኝ።
am.R: አንተ በገዛ እጆችህ ሠራኸኝ፤ ቀረጽኸኝም። ትእዛዛትህን እንድማር እንዳስተውል እርዳኝ።

hi.L: तेरे हाथों ने मुझे बनाया और स्थिर किया; मुझे समझ दे, कि मैं तेरी आज्ञाएँ सीखूँ।
hi.B: तेरे हाथों ने मुझे बनाया और गढ़ा; मुझे समझ दे, ताकि मैं तेरी आज्ञाएँ सीख सकूँ।
hi.R: तूने अपने ही हाथों से मुझे बनाया और रचा। समझने में मेरी सहायता कर, ताकि मैं तेरी आज्ञाएँ सीख सकूँ।

ru.L: Твои руки создали меня и утвердили меня; дай мне разумение, и я выучу {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} заповеди.
ru.B: Твои руки сотворили меня и придали мне облик; дай мне понимание, чтобы я мог выучить {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} заповеди.
ru.R: Ты создал меня своими руками и сделал меня таким, какой я есть. Помоги мне понять, чтобы я мог выучить {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} заповеди.

uk.L: Твої руки створили мене й утвердили мене; дай мені розуміння, щоб я навчився {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} заповідей.
uk.B: Твої руки створили мене й сформували мене; дай мені розуміння, щоб я міг навчитися {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} заповідей.
uk.R: Ти створив мене своїми власними руками й сформував мене. Допоможи мені зрозуміти, щоб я міг навчитися {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} заповідей.

decisions.reason: Each of the eight verses of this stanza begins with the letter yod, the tenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see 119:1). The first word, "your hands", begins with it.
The verb (konen) is to set up firmly; of a person, to fashion and make firm (Deuteronomy 32:6).
Job 10:8 uses the same picture: the one who made the psalmist can also teach him.

decisions.choice: commands: what God has told his people to do
decisions.reason: As in 119:6.

source.text: יְ֭רֵאֶיךָ יִרְא֣וּנִי וְיִשְׂמָ֑חוּ כִּ֖י לִדְבָרְךָ֣ יִחָֽלְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: Those fearing you will see me and rejoice, for for your word I have waited.

en.L: Those who fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will see me and rejoice, for I have waited for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.
en.B: Those who fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will be glad when they see me, for I have set my hope on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.
en.R: People who honor {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will be happy when they see me, because I counted on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.

fr.L: Ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craignent me verront et se réjouiront, car j’ai attendu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.
fr.B: Ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craignent seront heureux de me voir, car j’ai mis mon espoir dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.
fr.R: Ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}honorent seront heureux de me voir, parce que j’ai compté sur {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.

sw.L: Wale wanaokucha wataniona na kufurahi, kwa maana nimelingojea neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.
sw.B: Wale wanaokucha watafurahi wanaponiona, kwa maana nimeliwekea neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} tumaini langu.
sw.R: Watu wanaokuheshimu watafurahi wanaponiona, kwa sababu nililitegemea neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.

es.L: Los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temen me verán y se alegrarán, porque he esperado en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra.
es.B: Los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temen se alegrarán al verme, porque he puesto mi esperanza en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra.
es.R: Los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} honran se pondrán contentos al verme, porque confié en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra.

vi.L: Những người kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ thấy tôi và vui mừng, vì tôi đã trông đợi lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Những người kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ vui mừng khi thấy tôi, vì tôi đã đặt hy vọng nơi lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Những người tôn kính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ vui khi gặp tôi, vì tôi đã trông cậy vào lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 주님을 경외하는 자들이 저를 보고 기뻐할 것입니다, 제가 주님의 말씀을 기다렸기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 주님을 경외하는 사람들이 저를 보면 기뻐할 것입니다. 제가 주님의 말씀에 희망을 걸었기 때문입니다.
ko.R: 주님을 두려운 마음으로 섬기는 사람들이 저를 보면 기뻐할 것입니다. 제가 주님의 말씀을 믿고 기다렸기 때문입니다.

pt.L: Os que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temem me verão e se alegrarão, pois pela {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra esperei.
pt.B: Os que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temem ficarão contentes ao me ver, pois pus a minha esperança na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra.
pt.R: As pessoas que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} honram vão ficar felizes quando me virem, porque eu contei com a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra.

am.L: አንተን የሚፈሩ ያዩኛል፤ ደስም ይላቸዋል፤ ቃልህን ተስፋ አድርጌአለሁና።
am.B: ቃልህን ተስፋ አድርጌአለሁና አንተን የሚፈሩ ሲያዩኝ ደስ ይላቸዋል።
am.R: በቃልህ ስለ ተማመንኩ አንተን በአክብሮት የሚፈሩ ሰዎች ሲያዩኝ ደስ ይላቸዋል።

hi.L: तेरा भय माननेवाले मुझे देखकर आनंदित होंगे, क्योंकि मैंने तेरे वचन की आशा रखी है।
hi.B: जो तेरा भय मानते हैं, वे मुझे देखकर आनंदित होंगे, क्योंकि मैंने तेरे वचन पर आशा लगाई है।
hi.R: जो लोग तेरा आदर और भय मानते हैं, वे मुझे देखकर ख़ुश होंगे, क्योंकि मैंने तेरे वचन पर भरोसा रखा।

ru.L: Боящиеся {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} увидят меня и обрадуются, потому что я ждал {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} слова.
ru.B: Те, кто боится {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, обрадуются, увидев меня, ведь я возложил надежду на {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} слово.
ru.R: Люди, которые благоговеют перед {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}}, будут рады, когда увидят меня, потому что я рассчитывал на {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} слово.

uk.L: Ті, хто боїться {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, побачать мене й зрадіють, бо я чекав на {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} слово.
uk.B: Ті, хто боїться {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, зрадіють, побачивши мене, бо я поклав надію на {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} слово.
uk.R: Люди, які шанують {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, зрадіють, коли побачать мене, бо я покладався на {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} слово.

decisions.choice: will see and rejoice: or a wish, may they see
alternatives: may those who fear you see me and rejoice
decisions.reason: The verbs may state what will happen or express a wish.
As in 119:9.
Readable says reverence, since "боятся" alone can sound like terror, as the English Readable says "honor" (119:63) and as the poetry note's "благоговение" for the fear of the LORD.

source.text: יָדַ֣עְתִּי יְ֭הוָה כִּי־צֶ֣דֶק מִשְׁפָּטֶ֑יךָ וֶ֝אֱמוּנָ֗ה עִנִּיתָֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: I know, YHWH, that righteousness [are] your judgments, and [in] faithfulness you have afflicted me.

en.L: I know, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} judgments [are] righteousness, and [in] faithfulness {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have afflicted me.
en.B: I know, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} rulings are just, and that {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} brought me low because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are faithful.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, I know that {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} decisions are right. You made me suffer because {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are faithful to me.

fr.L: Je sais, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} jugements [sont] justice, et [qu’en] fidélité {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as affligé.
fr.B: Je sais, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décisions sont justes, et que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} m’as humilié parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es fidèle.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, je sais que {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décisions sont justes. Tu m’as fait souffrir parce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es fidèle envers moi.

sw.L: Ninajua, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwamba hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} [ni] haki, na [kwa] uaminifu umenitesa.
sw.B: Ninajua, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwamba hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} ni za haki, na kwamba ulinishusha chini kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni mwaminifu.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ninajua kwamba hukumu {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} ni za haki. Ulinifanya niteseke kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ni mwaminifu kwangu.

es.L: Sé, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} juicios [son] justicia, y [que con] fidelidad me has afligido.
es.B: Sé, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} dictámenes son justos, y que me has hecho pasar por la aflicción porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres fiel.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, sé que {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} decisiones son justas. Me hiciste sufrir porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres fiel conmigo.

vi.L: Tôi biết, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, rằng các phán quyết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] sự công chính, và [trong] sự thành tín {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm cho tôi khốn khổ.
vi.B: Tôi biết, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, rằng các phán quyết của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là công chính, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã hạ tôi xuống vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đấng thành tín.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tôi biết những quyết định của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đều đúng. Ngài đã để tôi chịu khổ vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thành tín với tôi.

ko.L: 제가 압니다, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 판결들은 의이며, 신실하심으로 주님께서 저를 괴롭게 하셨음을.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저는 압니다. 주님의 판결은 의롭고, 주님께서 신실하시기에 저를 낮추셨다는 것을.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저는 주님의 결정이 옳다는 것을 압니다. 주님께서 저에게 신실하시기에 저를 고난 받게 하셨습니다.

pt.L: Sei, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, que os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} juízos [são] justiça, e [com] fidelidade {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me afligiste.
pt.B: Eu sei, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, que as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} ordenanças são justas, e que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me abateste porque és fiel.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, eu sei que as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} decisões são certas. Tu me fizeste sofrer porque és fiel a mim.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ፍርዶችህ ጽድቅ እንደ ሆኑ፣ በታማኝነትም መከራ እንዳመጣህብኝ አውቃለሁ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ፍርዶችህ ፍትሐዊ እንደ ሆኑ፣ ታማኝ ስለሆንክም ዝቅ እንዳደረግኸኝ አውቃለሁ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ፍርዶችህ ትክክል እንደ ሆኑ አውቃለሁ። ለእኔ ታማኝ ስለሆንክ መከራ እንድቀበል አደረግኸኝ።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैं जानता हूँ कि तेरे नियम धर्म ही [हैं], और सच्चाई से तूने मुझे दुःख दिया है।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैं जानता हूँ कि तेरे नियम न्यायपूर्ण हैं, और तूने मुझे इसलिए दबाया क्योंकि तू विश्वासयोग्य है।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मैं जानता हूँ कि तेरे फ़ैसले सही हैं। तूने मुझे दुःख इसलिए दिया क्योंकि तू मेरे प्रति विश्वासयोग्य है।

ru.L: Я знаю, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, что {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} правила — праведность и [по] верности {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} угнетал меня.
ru.B: Я знаю, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, что {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} правила справедливы и что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} смирил меня, потому что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} верен.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, я знаю, что {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} решения правильны. Ты дал мне пострадать, потому что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} верен мне.

uk.L: Я знаю, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, що {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} присуди — праведність, і [у] вірності {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} впокорив мене.
uk.B: Я знаю, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, що {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} присуди справедливі і що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} впокорив мене, бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вірний.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, я знаю, що {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} рішення правильні. Ти дав мені страждати, бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вірний мені.

decisions.choice: judgments: God's rulings, his decisions about what is right
decisions.reason: As in 119:7.

decisions.choice: in faithfulness you have afflicted me
decisions.reason: The hardship the psalmist went through was not a sign that God had left him but part of God's faithful care, as a father disciplines a son (Deuteronomy 8:5).
Readable says to whom God is faithful.

decisions.choice: "सच्चाई" (L); "विश्वासयोग्य" (B, R) for God's faithfulness, through the psalm
decisions.reason: God's 'emunah is "सच्चाई" at Literal and "विश्वासयोग्यता" at Balanced and Readable, as the poetry terms note settles; here Balanced and Readable say it with the adjective, as the English says "because you are faithful".

records.literal_gloss: Let, please, your loyal love be to comfort me, according to your saying to your servant.

en.L: Let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, please, be for my comfort, according to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} saying to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant.
en.B: Let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love comfort me, I pray, as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} promise to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant said.
en.R: Please let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love comfort me, just as {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} promise to me, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant, said.

fr.L: Que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie, soit pour me consoler, selon {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} propos à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur.
fr.B: Que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle me console, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie, comme {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} promesse à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur l’a dit.
fr.R: S’il {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} plaît, que {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle me console, comme {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} promesse me l’a dit, à moi, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur.

sw.L: Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, tafadhali, uwe faraja yangu, kulingana na kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kwa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}.
sw.B: Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma unifariji, nakuomba, kama kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kwa mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ilivyosema.
sw.R: Tafadhali upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma unifariji, kama kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} kwangu mimi mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} ilivyosema.

es.L: Sea, por favor, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal para consolarme, conforme a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dicho a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo.
es.B: Que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel me consuele, {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} lo ruego, como dijo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} promesa a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo.
es.R: Por favor, que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel me consuele, tal como lo dijo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} promesa hecha a mí, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo.

vi.L: Xin cho tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm niềm an ủi cho tôi, theo lời phán của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Xin cho tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} an ủi tôi, như lời hứa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Xin cho tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} an ủi tôi, đúng như lời hứa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với tôi, là đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 주님의 한결같은 사랑이, 부디, 저의 위로가 되게 하십시오, 주님의 종에게 주님께서 하신 말씀대로.
ko.B: 주님의 종에게 하신 약속대로, 주님의 한결같은 사랑이 저를 위로하게 해 주십시오.
ko.R: 주님의 종인 저에게 약속하신 대로, 부디 주님의 변함없는 사랑으로 저를 위로해 주십시오.

pt.L: Seja, por favor, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal para o meu consolo, conforme o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} dito ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo.
pt.B: Que o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal me console, eu {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} peço, como a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} promessa ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo disse.
pt.R: Por favor, que o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor fiel me console, como diz a promessa que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fizeste a mim, o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo.

am.L: እባክህ፣ ጽኑ ፍቅርህ ያጽናናኝ፣ ለባሪያህ እንደ ሆነው ንግግርህ።
am.B: ለአገልጋይህ የሰጠኸው ተስፋ ቃል እንደሚለው፣ እባክህ፣ ጽኑ ፍቅርህ ያጽናናኝ።
am.R: ለእኔ ለአገልጋይህ የሰጠኸው ተስፋ ቃል እንደሚለው፣ እባክህ፣ ጽኑ ፍቅርህ ያጽናናኝ።

hi.L: तेरा अटल प्रेम, कृपया, मेरी सांत्वना के लिए हो, तेरे उस कथन के अनुसार जो तूने अपने दास से कहा।
hi.B: तेरा अटल प्रेम मुझे सांत्वना दे, मैं विनती करता हूँ, जैसा तेरी प्रतिज्ञा ने तेरे दास से कहा था।
hi.R: कृपया अपने अटल प्रेम से मुझे तसल्ली दे, जैसा तेरी प्रतिज्ञा ने मुझसे, तेरे दास से, कहा था।

ru.L: Пусть же {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} неизменная любовь будет мне утешением, по {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} речению {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} рабу.
ru.B: Пусть {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} неизменная любовь утешит меня, прошу, как сказано в {{deity_pronoun:твоём|Твоём}} обещании {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} рабу.
ru.R: Пожалуйста, пусть {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} неизменная любовь утешит меня, как {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} и обещал мне, {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} рабу.

uk.L: Нехай же {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} незмінна любов буде мені на втіху, за {{deity_pronoun:твоїм|Твоїм}} висловом до {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} раба.
uk.B: Нехай {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} незмінна любов утішить мене, благаю, як сказала {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} обіцянка {{deity_pronoun:твоєму|Твоєму}} рабові.
uk.R: Будь ласка, нехай {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} вірна любов утішить мене, як {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} обіцяв мені, {{deity_pronoun:твоєму|Твоєму}} рабові.

decisions.reason: The verb (nicham) is related to the one in verses 52 and 82.

decisions.choice: saying: what God has said, often his promise

decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

records.literal_gloss: Let your compassions come to me, that I may live, for your instruction [is] my delight.

en.L: Let {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} compassion come to me, that I may live, for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction [is] my delight.
en.B: Send {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} tender mercy to me so that I may live; {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction is what I delight in.
en.R: Be kind and gentle with me so that I may live. Your teaching gives me joy.

fr.L: Que viennent sur moi {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} compassions, pour que je vive, car {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi [est] mes délices.
fr.B: Envoie-moi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} tendresse pour que je vive ; {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} instruction fait mes délices.
fr.R: Sois doux et bon avec moi, pour que je vive. Ton enseignement me rend heureux.

sw.L: Rehema {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zinijie, ili niishi, kwa maana mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} [ni] furaha yangu.
sw.B: Uniletee huruma {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} nyororo ili niishi; mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} ndiyo ninayoyafurahia.
sw.R: Unionee huruma na upole ili niishi. Mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yananipa furaha.

es.L: Venga a mí {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} compasión, para que viva, porque {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción [es] mi deleite.
es.B: Envíame {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} tierna misericordia para que viva; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción es mi deleite.
es.R: Sé bondadoso y tierno conmigo para que viva. Tu enseñanza me da alegría.

vi.L: Xin cho lòng thương xót của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến với tôi, để tôi được sống, vì sự dạy dỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] niềm vui thích của tôi.
vi.B: Xin ban lòng thương xót dịu dàng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho tôi để tôi được sống; lời dạy dỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là điều tôi vui thích.
vi.R: Xin đối xử nhân từ và dịu dàng với tôi để tôi được sống. Lời dạy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm tôi vui.

ko.L: 주님의 긍휼이 저에게 임하게 하십시오, 제가 살도록. 주님의 가르침이 저의 즐거움이기 때문입니다.
ko.B: 주님의 따뜻한 자비를 저에게 베푸셔서 제가 살게 해 주십시오. 주님의 가르침은 저의 기쁨입니다.
ko.R: 저에게 친절하고 부드럽게 대해 주셔서 제가 살게 해 주십시오. 주님의 가르침은 저에게 기쁨을 줍니다.

pt.L: Venham a mim as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} compaixões, para que eu viva, pois o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} ensino [é] o meu prazer.
pt.B: Envia-me a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} terna misericórdia para que eu viva; o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} ensino é o meu prazer.
pt.R: Trata-me com carinho e bondade, para que eu viva. Os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} ensinamentos me dão alegria.

am.L: ርኅራኄህ ወደ እኔ ይምጣ፣ በሕይወት እኖር ዘንድ፤ ሕግህ ደስታዬ ነውና።
am.B: በሕይወት እንድኖር ርኅራኄህን ላክልኝ፤ ደስታዬ ሕግህ ነው።
am.R: በሕይወት እንድኖር ራራልኝ፤ በርኅራኄም ያዘኝ። ሕግህ ደስታ ይሰጠኛል።

hi.L: तेरी करुणा मुझ तक पहुँचे, कि मैं जीवित रहूँ, क्योंकि तेरी व्यवस्था मेरा आनंद [है]।
hi.B: अपनी कोमल करुणा मुझ तक भेज, ताकि मैं जीवित रहूँ; तेरी व्यवस्था ही मेरा आनंद है।
hi.R: मुझ पर दया और कोमलता दिखा, ताकि मैं जीवित रहूँ। तेरी शिक्षा से मुझे आनंद मिलता है।

ru.L: Пусть придёт ко мне {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} сострадание, и я буду жить, потому что {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} Закон — моя отрада.
ru.B: Пошли мне {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} нежное милосердие, чтобы я жил; {{deity_pronoun:твой|Твой}} Закон — то, чем я наслаждаюсь.
ru.R: Будь добр и мягок со мной, чтобы я жил. Твоё наставление приносит мне радость.

uk.L: Нехай прийде до мене {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} милосердя, щоб я жив, бо {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} настанова — моя втіха.
uk.B: Пошли мені {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} ніжне милосердя, щоб я жив; {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} настанова — те, чим я тішуся.
uk.R: Будь добрим і лагідним до мене, щоб я жив. Твоє навчання дає мені радість.

decisions.reason: The word (rachamim) is related to the word for the womb: the tender love of a parent (103:13). It is plural, for many acts of mercy.
As in 119:1.

decisions.choice: be kind and gentle with me
alternatives: let your compassion come to me
decisions.reason: Readable says what God's compassion coming means.

source.text: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ זֵ֭דִים כִּי־שֶׁ֣קֶר עִוְּת֑וּנִי אֲ֝נִ֗י אָשִׂ֥יחַ בְּפִקּוּדֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let [the] arrogant be put to shame, for [with] falsehood they have wronged me; I, I will meditate on your precepts.

en.L: Let the arrogant be put to shame, for with lies they have wronged me; as for me, I will meditate on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.B: Let the proud be disgraced, for they have twisted the truth to harm me; but I will ponder {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.R: Let proud people be put to shame, because they told lies to hurt me. But I will think deeply about {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instructions.

fr.L: Qu’ils soient couverts de honte, les orgueilleux, car par le mensonge ils m’ont fait du tort ; moi, je méditerai sur {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.B: Que les orgueilleux soient déshonorés, car ils ont tordu la vérité pour me nuire ; mais moi, je méditerai {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.R: Que les orgueilleux aient honte, parce qu’ils ont menti pour me faire du mal. Mais moi, je réfléchirai profondément à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} consignes.

sw.L: Wenye kiburi waaibishwe, kwa maana kwa uongo wamenidhulumu; mimi, nitayatafakari maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Wenye kiburi waaibike, kwa maana wameupotosha ukweli ili kunidhuru; lakini mimi nitayatafakari maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Watu wenye kiburi waaibishwe, kwa sababu walisema uongo ili kuniumiza. Lakini mimi nitayafikiria sana maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

es.L: Sean avergonzados los soberbios, porque con mentira me han agraviado; en cuanto a mí, meditaré en {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} preceptos.
es.B: Que los orgullosos queden en deshonra, porque han torcido la verdad para hacerme daño; pero yo reflexionaré en {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} preceptos.
es.R: Que los orgullosos pasen vergüenza, porque dijeron mentiras para hacerme daño. Pero yo pensaré mucho en {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} instrucciones.

vi.L: Nguyện những kẻ kiêu ngạo bị hổ thẹn, vì chúng đã dùng điều dối trá làm hại tôi; còn tôi, tôi sẽ suy ngẫm các huấn lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Nguyện những kẻ kiêu căng bị nhục nhã, vì chúng đã bóp méo sự thật để hại tôi; nhưng tôi sẽ suy ngẫm các huấn lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Nguyện những kẻ kiêu ngạo bị xấu hổ, vì chúng đã nói dối để hại tôi. Nhưng tôi sẽ suy nghĩ kỹ về những lời chỉ dẫn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 교만한 자들이 부끄러움을 당하게 하십시오, 그들이 거짓으로 저를 해쳤기 때문입니다. 저는 주님의 법도들을 묵상하겠습니다.
ko.B: 교만한 자들이 수치를 당하게 해 주십시오. 그들이 진실을 굽혀 저를 해쳤습니다. 그러나 저는 주님의 법도를 깊이 생각하겠습니다.
ko.R: 교만한 사람들이 부끄러움을 당하게 해 주십시오. 그들은 거짓말로 저를 해쳤습니다. 그러나 저는 주님의 지시를 곰곰이 생각하겠습니다.

pt.L: Sejam envergonhados os arrogantes, pois com mentira me prejudicaram; eu, meditarei nos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} preceitos.
pt.B: Que os orgulhosos sejam humilhados, pois torceram a verdade para me fazer mal; mas eu refletirei sobre os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} preceitos.
pt.R: Que as pessoas orgulhosas passem vergonha, porque contaram mentiras para me prejudicar. Mas eu vou pensar a fundo nas {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} instruções.

am.L: ትዕቢተኞች ያፍሩ፤ በሐሰት በድለውኛልና፤ እኔ ግን መመሪያዎችህን አሰላስላለሁ።
am.B: እውነትን አጣመው ጎድተውኛልና ትዕቢተኞች ይዋረዱ፤ እኔ ግን መመሪያዎችህን በጥልቅ አስባለሁ።
am.R: ሊጎዱኝ ስለ ዋሹ ትዕቢተኞች ያፍሩ። እኔ ግን ስለ መመሪያዎችህ በጥልቅ አስባለሁ።

hi.L: अभिमानी लज्जित हों, क्योंकि उन्होंने झूठ से मेरे साथ अन्याय किया है; पर मैं तेरे आदेशों पर मनन करूँगा।
hi.B: अभिमानी अपमानित हों, क्योंकि उन्होंने मुझे हानि पहुँचाने के लिए सच को तोड़ा-मरोड़ा है; पर मैं तेरे आदेशों पर विचार करूँगा।
hi.R: घमंडी लोग लज्जित हों, क्योंकि उन्होंने मुझे चोट पहुँचाने के लिए झूठ बोला। पर मैं तेरे निर्देशों के बारे में गहराई से सोचूँगा।

ru.L: Пусть будут посрамлены надменные, потому что ложью они притесняли меня; я же буду размышлять о {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} наказах.
ru.B: Пусть гордые будут опозорены, потому что они исказили правду, чтобы навредить мне; а я буду размышлять о {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} наказах.
ru.R: Пусть гордым людям будет стыдно, потому что они лгали, чтобы навредить мне. А я буду много думать о {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} указаниях.

uk.L: Нехай будуть осоромлені зарозумілі, бо брехнею вони скривдили мене; а я розмірковуватиму про {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} накази.
uk.B: Нехай горді зазнають ганьби, бо вони перекрутили правду, щоб мені зашкодити; а я роздумуватиму над {{deity_pronoun:твоїми|Твоїми}} наказами.
uk.R: Нехай горді люди будуть осоромлені, бо вони брехали, щоб мені зашкодити. А я багато думатиму над {{deity_pronoun:твоїми|Твоїми}} вказівками.

decisions.reason: The verb ('iwwet) is to bend or falsify; they have twisted the truth to bring the psalmist down (Job 8:3; Lamentations 3:36).

decisions.choice: precepts: the charges God has laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:4.

records.literal_gloss: Let those fearing you turn to me, and those knowing your testimonies.

en.L: Let those who fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} turn to me, and those who know {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} testimonies.
en.B: Let those who fear {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} come back to me, those who know {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} decrees.
en.R: Let the people who honor {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} come back to me, the ones who know what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have declared.

fr.L: Qu’ils se tournent vers moi, ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craignent, et ceux qui connaissent {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} témoignages.
fr.B: Que ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} craignent reviennent vers moi, ceux qui connaissent {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décrets.
fr.R: Que ceux qui {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}honorent reviennent vers moi, ceux qui connaissent ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as déclaré.

sw.L: Wale wanaokucha wanigeukie, na wale wanaozijua shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.B: Wale wanaokucha warudi kwangu, wale wanaozijua shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.
sw.R: Watu wanaokuheshimu warudi kwangu, wale wanaozijua shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

es.L: Vuélvanse a mí los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temen, y los que conocen {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} testimonios.
es.B: Que vuelvan a mí los que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temen, los que conocen {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} decretos.
es.R: Que la gente que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} honra vuelva a mí, los que conocen lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has declarado.

vi.L: Nguyện những người kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} quay về với tôi, và những người biết các lời chứng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Nguyện những người kính sợ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trở lại với tôi, là những người biết các lời chứng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Nguyện những người tôn kính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trở lại với tôi, là những người biết những điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã công bố.

ko.L: 주님을 경외하는 자들이 저에게로 돌아오게 하십시오, 주님의 증언들을 아는 자들이.
ko.B: 주님을 경외하는 사람들, 주님의 증언을 아는 사람들이 제게로 돌아오게 해 주십시오.
ko.R: 주님을 두려운 마음으로 섬기는 사람들, 주님께서 알려 주신 뜻을 아는 사람들이 제게 다시 돌아오게 해 주십시오.

pt.L: Voltem-se para mim os que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temem, e os que conhecem os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} testemunhos.
pt.B: Que voltem para mim os que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} temem, os que conhecem os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} decretos.
pt.R: Que as pessoas que {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} honram voltem para perto de mim, as que conhecem o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} declaraste.

am.L: አንተን የሚፈሩ ወደ እኔ ይመለሱ፣ ምስክርነቶችህንም የሚያውቁ።
am.B: አንተን የሚፈሩ፣ ምስክርነቶችህን የሚያውቁ ወደ እኔ ይመለሱ።
am.R: አንተን በአክብሮት የሚፈሩ ሰዎች፣ ምስክርነቶችህን የሚያውቁት፣ ወደ እኔ ይመለሱ።

hi.L: तेरा भय माननेवाले मेरी ओर फिरें, और वे जो तेरी चितौनियों को जानते हैं।
hi.B: जो तेरा भय मानते हैं, वे मेरे पास लौट आएँ, वे जो तेरी चितौनियों को जानते हैं।
hi.R: जो लोग तेरा आदर और भय मानते हैं, वे मेरे पास लौट आएँ, वे जो तेरी घोषणाओं को जानते हैं।

ru.L: Пусть обратятся ко мне боящиеся {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} и знающие {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} свидетельства.
ru.B: Пусть вернутся ко мне те, кто боится {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, те, кто знает {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} постановления.
ru.R: Пусть вернутся ко мне люди, которые благоговеют перед {{deity_pronoun:тобой|Тобой}}, те, кто знает, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} возвестил.

uk.L: Нехай повернуться до мене ті, хто боїться {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, і ті, хто знає {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} свідчення.
uk.B: Нехай повернуться до мене ті, хто боїться {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, ті, хто знає {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} свідчення.
uk.R: Нехай повернуться до мене люди, які шанують {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, ті, хто знає, що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} проголосив.

decisions.choice: and those who know: the form to be read
alternatives: so that they may know your testimonies
decisions.reason: The words follow the form to be read. The written form seems to read "and they will know", making the second line the purpose of the first; the sense is close.

decisions.choice: turn to me: come back to me
decisions.reason: The verb (shuv) is to turn or return; those who fear God may have drawn back while the psalmist suffered.

decisions.choice: testimonies: what God has solemnly declared
decisions.reason: As in 119:2.

source.text: יְהִֽי־לִבִּ֣י תָמִ֣ים בְּחֻקֶּ֑יךָ לְ֝מַ֗עַן לֹ֣א אֵבֽוֹשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let my heart be blameless in your statutes, so that I may not be ashamed.

en.L: May my heart be blameless in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes, so that I may not be put to shame.
en.B: Let my heart be whole in keeping {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes, so that I will not be disgraced.
en.R: Help me obey {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} laws with all my heart, so that I will not be ashamed.

fr.L: Que mon cœur soit intègre dans {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions, afin que je ne sois pas couvert de honte.
fr.B: Que mon cœur reste entier dans l’observation de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions, pour que je ne sois pas déshonoré.
fr.R: Aide-moi à obéir à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lois de tout mon cœur, pour que je n’aie pas honte.

sw.L: Moyo wangu uwe mkamilifu katika kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, ili nisiaibishwe.
sw.B: Moyo wangu uwe mzima katika kuzishika kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}, ili nisiaibike.
sw.R: Unisaidie kuzitii kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} kwa moyo wangu wote, ili nisione aibu.

es.L: Sea mi corazón íntegro en {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} estatutos, para que no me avergüence.
es.B: Que mi corazón sea íntegro al cumplir {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} estatutos, para que no quede en deshonra.
es.R: Ayúdame a obedecer {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} leyes con todo mi corazón, para que no pase vergüenza.

vi.L: Nguyện lòng tôi trọn vẹn trong các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để tôi không bị hổ thẹn.
vi.B: Nguyện lòng tôi trọn vẹn trong việc gìn giữ các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để tôi không bị nhục nhã.
vi.R: Xin giúp tôi hết lòng vâng theo luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để tôi không phải xấu hổ.

ko.L: 제 마음이 주님의 규례들 안에서 흠이 없게 하십시오, 제가 부끄러움을 당하지 않도록.
ko.B: 제 마음이 주님의 규례를 지키는 데 온전하게 해 주십시오. 그러면 제가 수치를 당하지 않을 것입니다.
ko.R: 제가 온 마음으로 주님의 법을 따르도록 도와주십시오. 그러면 부끄러움을 당하지 않을 것입니다.

pt.L: Seja o meu coração íntegro nos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} estatutos, para que eu não seja envergonhado.
pt.B: Que o meu coração seja inteiro no cumprimento dos {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} estatutos, para que eu não seja humilhado.
pt.R: Ajuda-me a obedecer às {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} leis de todo o coração, para que eu não fique envergonhado.

am.L: ልቤ በሥርዓቶችህ ነውር የሌለበት ይሁን፣ እንዳላፍር።
am.B: እንዳልዋረድ ልቤ በሥርዓቶችህ ፍጹም ይሁን።
am.R: እንዳላፍር ሥርዓቶችህን በሙሉ ልቤ እንድከተል እርዳኝ።

hi.L: मेरा हृदय तेरी विधियों में निर्दोष हो, ताकि मैं लज्जित न होऊँ।
hi.B: तेरी विधियों के पालन में मेरा हृदय खरा रहे, ताकि मैं अपमानित न होऊँ।
hi.R: पूरे मन से तेरी विधियों का पालन करने में मेरी सहायता कर, ताकि मुझे शर्मिंदा न होना पड़े।

ru.L: Пусть будет моё сердце безупречно в {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} установлениях, чтобы мне не быть посрамлённым.
ru.B: Пусть моё сердце будет цельным в соблюдении {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} установлений, чтобы я не был опозорен.
ru.R: Помоги мне всем сердцем исполнять {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} законы, чтобы мне не было стыдно.

uk.L: Нехай моє серце буде непорочне в {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} постановах, щоб я не був осоромлений.
uk.B: Нехай моє серце буде цілісне, щоб берегти {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} постанови, і я не зазнаю ганьби.
uk.R: Допоможи мені всім серцем слухатися {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} законів, щоб мені не було соромно.

decisions.reason: As in 119:1.

decisions.choice: statutes: rules that are fixed and laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:5.
As in 119:6.

decisions.choice: help me obey ... with all my heart
decisions.reason: Readable turns the wish into a prayer and says what a whole heart means.

records.literal_gloss: My soul is spent for your salvation; for your word I have waited.

en.L: My soul faints for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} salvation; for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word I have waited.
en.B: I am worn out with longing for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} rescue; I have set my hope on {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.
en.R: I long so much for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} to save me that I have no strength left. Still, I keep hoping in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word.

fr.L: Mon âme se consume pour {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} salut ; j’ai attendu {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.
fr.B: Je m’épuise à désirer {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} salut ; j’ai mis mon espoir dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.
fr.R: Je désire tellement que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me sauves que je n’ai plus de force. Pourtant, je continue d’espérer en {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole.

sw.L: Nafsi yangu inazimia kwa ajili ya wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} nimelingojea.
sw.B: Nimechoka kwa kuutamani wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; nimeliwekea neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} tumaini langu.
sw.R: Ninatamani sana uniokoe hata sina nguvu tena. Hata hivyo, ninaendelea kulitumainia neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}}.

es.L: Desfallece mi alma por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} salvación; en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra he esperado.
es.B: Me consumo de anhelo por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} salvación; he puesto mi esperanza en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra.
es.R: Deseo tanto que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} me salves que ya no me quedan fuerzas. Aun así, sigo esperando en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra.

vi.L: Linh hồn tôi mòn mỏi vì [trông] sự cứu rỗi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; tôi đã trông đợi lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Tôi hao mòn vì mong mỏi sự giải cứu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; tôi đã đặt hy vọng nơi lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Tôi mong được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cứu đến nỗi chẳng còn chút sức lực nào. Dù vậy, tôi vẫn hy vọng nơi lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 제 영혼이 주님의 구원을 사모하여 쇠약해졌습니다. 주님의 말씀을 제가 기다렸습니다.
ko.B: 주님의 구원을 사모하다가 저는 지쳐 버렸습니다. 저는 주님의 말씀에 희망을 걸었습니다.
ko.R: 저는 주님께서 구해 주시기를 너무나 기다리다가 힘이 다 빠졌습니다. 그래도 주님의 말씀에 계속 희망을 둡니다.

pt.L: A minha alma desfalece pela {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} salvação; pela {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra esperei.
pt.B: Estou esgotado de tanto ansiar pelo {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} socorro; pus a minha esperança na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra.
pt.R: Quero tanto que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me salves que já não tenho forças. Mesmo assim, continuo esperando na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra.

am.L: ነፍሴ ማዳንህን [በመናፈቅ] ደከመች፤ ቃልህን ተስፋ አደረግኩ።
am.B: ማዳንህን በመናፈቅ ዝያለሁ፤ ተስፋዬን በቃልህ ላይ ጥያለሁ።
am.R: እንድታድነኝ በጣም ስለ ናፈቅኩ ምንም ኃይል አልቀረልኝም። ቢሆንም በቃልህ ተስፋ ማድረጌን እቀጥላለሁ።

hi.L: मेरा प्राण तेरे उद्धार के लिए मूर्च्छित हो चला है; मैंने तेरे वचन की आशा रखी है।
hi.B: तेरे उद्धार की लालसा में मैं थककर चूर हो गया हूँ; मैंने तेरे वचन पर आशा लगाई है।
hi.R: मैं इतना तरसता हूँ कि तू मुझे बचाए, कि मुझमें कोई बल नहीं बचा। फिर भी मैं तेरे वचन पर आशा रखे हुए हूँ।

ru.L: Изнемогает душа моя по {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} спасению; {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} слова я ждал.
ru.B: Я изнемогаю от тоски по {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} спасению; я возложил надежду на {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} слово.
ru.R: Я так хочу, чтобы {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} спас меня, что у меня не осталось сил. И всё же я продолжаю надеяться на {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} слово.

uk.L: Знемагає моя душа за {{deity_pronoun:твоїм|Твоїм}} спасінням; на {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} слово я чекав.
uk.B: Я виснажився від туги за {{deity_pronoun:твоїм|Твоїм}} спасінням; я поклав надію на {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} слово.
uk.R: Я так прагну, щоб {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} врятував мене, що в мене не лишилося сил. І все ж я далі надіюся на {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} слово.

decisions.reason: Each of the eight verses of this stanza begins with the letter kaph, the eleventh letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see 119:1). Verses 81-87 are the darkest part of the psalm so far.
The verb (kalah) is to come to an end, to be used up. It comes again in verse 82, and in verse 87 of the enemies who almost made an end of the psalmist.
As in 119:9.
As in the earlier psalms, Literal keeps "soul" (nefesh) and Balanced and Readable say what it means here, the whole person.

source.text: כָּל֣וּ עֵ֭ינַי לְאִמְרָתֶ֑ךָ לֵ֝אמֹ֗ר מָתַ֥י תְּֽנַחֲמֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: My eyes are spent for your saying, saying: when will you comfort me?

en.L: My eyes fail for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} saying, as I say: when will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} comfort me?
en.B: My eyes grow dim as I watch for {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} promise; I keep asking when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will comfort me.
en.R: My eyes are tired from watching for what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} promised. I keep asking when {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will comfort me.

fr.L: Mes yeux se consument pour {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} propos, et je dis : « Quand me consoleras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ? »
fr.B: Mes yeux se fatiguent à guetter {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} promesse ; je ne cesse de demander quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me consoleras.
fr.R: Mes yeux sont fatigués d’attendre ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as promis. Je demande sans cesse quand {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vas me consoler.

sw.L: Macho yangu yanafifia kwa ajili ya kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, nikisema: utanifariji lini?
sw.B: Macho yangu yanafifia ninapoingojea kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; ninaendelea kuuliza ni lini utanifariji.
sw.R: Macho yangu yamechoka kwa kuingojea kauli {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}. Ninaendelea kuuliza ni lini utanifariji.

es.L: Desfallecen mis ojos por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} dicho, mientras digo: ¿cuándo me consolarás?
es.B: Se me nublan los ojos mientras espero {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} promesa; sigo preguntando cuándo me consolarás.
es.R: Tengo los ojos cansados de esperar lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} prometiste. Sigo preguntando cuándo me vas a consolar.

vi.L: Mắt tôi mòn mỏi vì [trông] lời phán của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, trong khi tôi nói: khi nào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ an ủi tôi?
vi.B: Mắt tôi mờ đi vì trông chờ lời hứa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; tôi cứ hỏi khi nào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ an ủi tôi.
vi.R: Mắt tôi mỏi mệt vì trông chờ lời hứa của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Tôi cứ hỏi khi nào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ an ủi tôi.

ko.L: 제 눈이 주님께서 하신 말씀을 바라다 흐려졌습니다, 제가 "언제 주님께서 저를 위로하시겠습니까?" 하고 말하면서.
ko.B: 주님의 약속을 기다리다 제 눈이 흐려졌습니다. "주님께서 언제 저를 위로하시겠습니까?" 하고 저는 계속 여쭙니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 약속하신 것을 기다리느라 제 눈이 지쳤습니다. 주님께서 언제 저를 위로해 주실지 저는 계속 여쭙니다.

pt.L: Os meus olhos desfalecem pelo {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} dito, enquanto digo: quando {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me consolarás?
pt.B: Os meus olhos se apagam enquanto aguardo a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} promessa; continuo perguntando quando {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} me consolarás.
pt.R: Os meus olhos estão cansados de esperar o que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} prometeste. Continuo perguntando quando {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vais me consolar.

am.L: ዓይኖቼ ንግግርህን [በመጠበቅ] ደከሙ፤ መቼ ታጽናናኛለህ? እላለሁ።
am.B: ተስፋ ቃልህን ስጠባበቅ ዓይኖቼ ፈዘዙ፤ መቼ እንደምታጽናናኝ ደጋግሜ እጠይቃለሁ።
am.R: ተስፋ ቃልህን በመጠባበቅ ዓይኖቼ ደከሙ። መቼ እንደምታጽናናኝ ደጋግሜ እጠይቃለሁ።

hi.L: मेरी आँखें तेरे कथन की बाट जोहते-जोहते धुँधला गई हैं, और मैं कहता हूँ: तू मुझे कब सांत्वना देगा?
hi.B: तेरी प्रतिज्ञा की राह देखते-देखते मेरी आँखें धुँधली पड़ गई हैं; मैं बार-बार पूछता हूँ कि तू मुझे कब सांत्वना देगा।
hi.R: तेरी प्रतिज्ञा के पूरे होने की राह देखते-देखते मेरी आँखें थक गई हैं। मैं बार-बार पूछता हूँ कि तू मुझे कब तसल्ली देगा।

ru.L: Истомились мои глаза по {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} речению, [и] я говорю: когда {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} утешишь меня?
ru.B: Мои глаза тускнеют, пока я высматриваю {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} обещание; я всё спрашиваю, когда {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} утешишь меня.
ru.R: Мои глаза устали высматривать то, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} обещал. Я всё спрашиваю, когда {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} утешишь меня.

uk.L: Знемагають мої очі за {{deity_pronoun:твоїм|Твоїм}} висловом, і я кажу: коли {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} втішиш мене?
uk.B: Мої очі тьмяніють, доки я виглядаю {{deity_pronoun:твоєї|Твоєї}} обіцянки; я все питаю, коли {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} втішиш мене.
uk.R: Мої очі втомилися виглядати того, що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} пообіцяв. Я все питаю, коли {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} мене втішиш.

decisions.choice: my eyes fail: I have watched until I can watch no longer
decisions.reason: Eyes that fail are worn out with looking for help that does not come (69:4).

decisions.choice: saying: what God has said, often his promise

decisions.reason: The question is the psalmist's own; as elsewhere, his own words are not put in quotation marks.

source.text: כִּֽי־הָ֭יִיתִי כְּנֹ֣אד בְּקִיט֑וֹר חֻ֝קֶּ֗יךָ לֹ֣א שָׁכָֽחְתִּי׃

records.literal_gloss: For I have become like a wineskin in smoke; your statutes I have not forgotten.

en.L: For I have become like a wineskin in smoke; {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes I have not forgotten.
en.B: I am like a skin bottle dried and cracked in the smoke, yet {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} statutes have not slipped my mind.
en.R: I am dried up and useless, like an old leather bottle hanging in smoke. But I have not forgotten {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} laws.

fr.L: Car je suis devenu comme une outre dans la fumée ; je n’ai pas oublié {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions.
fr.B: Je suis comme une outre desséchée et fendue par la fumée, mais {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} prescriptions ne sont pas sorties de ma mémoire.
fr.R: Je suis desséché et inutile, comme une vieille gourde en cuir suspendue dans la fumée. Mais je n’ai pas oublié {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} lois.

sw.L: Kwa maana nimekuwa kama kiriba katika moshi; kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} sijazisahau.
sw.B: Nimekuwa kama kiriba cha ngozi kilichokauka na kupasuka katika moshi, lakini kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} hazijatoka akilini mwangu.
sw.R: Nimekauka na sina faida, kama kiriba cha zamani cha ngozi kilichotundikwa mahali penye moshi. Lakini sijazisahau kanuni {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}.

es.L: Porque he llegado a ser como un odre en el humo; {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} estatutos no he olvidado.
es.B: Soy como un odre reseco y agrietado por el humo, pero {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} estatutos no se me han olvidado.
es.R: Mi vida se ha secado y no sirve para nada, como un viejo odre de cuero colgado en el humo. Pero no he olvidado {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} leyes.

vi.L: Vì tôi đã trở nên như cái bầu da trong khói; các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, tôi đã không quên.
vi.B: Tôi như chiếc bầu da bị khói hun khô nứt, nhưng tôi không để các luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} phai khỏi trí nhớ.
vi.R: Tôi khô héo và vô dụng, như một chiếc bình da cũ treo trong khói. Nhưng tôi không quên luật lệ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 참으로 제가 연기 속의 가죽 부대처럼 되었으나, 주님의 규례들을 잊지 않았습니다.
ko.B: 저는 연기에 그을려 메마르고 갈라진 가죽 부대 같지만, 주님의 규례를 잊지 않았습니다.
ko.R: 저는 연기 속에 매달린 낡은 가죽 병처럼 바싹 마르고 쓸모없게 되었습니다. 그러나 주님의 법을 잊지 않았습니다.

pt.L: Pois me tornei como um odre na fumaça; os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} estatutos não esqueci.
pt.B: Estou como um odre de couro ressecado e rachado na fumaça, mas os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} estatutos não me fugiram da memória.
pt.R: Estou seco e sem utilidade, como uma velha garrafa de couro pendurada na fumaça. Mas não esqueci as {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} leis.

am.L: በእርግጥም በጢስ ውስጥ እንዳለ አቁማዳ ሆኛለሁ፤ ሥርዓቶችህን አልረሳሁም።
am.B: በጢስ ውስጥ ደርቆ እንደ ተሰነጠቀ የቆዳ አቁማዳ ሆኛለሁ፤ ሥርዓቶችህ ግን ከአእምሮዬ አልጠፉም።
am.R: በጢስ ውስጥ ተሰቅሎ እንደ ደረቀ አሮጌ የቆዳ አቁማዳ ደርቄ የማልጠቅም ሆኛለሁ። ሥርዓቶችህን ግን አልረሳሁም።

hi.L: क्योंकि मैं धुएँ में [पड़ी] कुप्पी के समान हो गया हूँ; तेरी विधियों को मैं नहीं भूला।
hi.B: मैं उस चमड़े की कुप्पी के समान हूँ जो धुएँ में सूखकर चटक गई हो, फिर भी तेरी विधियाँ मेरे मन से नहीं उतरीं।
hi.R: मैं धुएँ में लटकी पुरानी चमड़े की कुप्पी की तरह सूखा और बेकार हो गया हूँ। पर मैं तेरी विधियों को नहीं भूला।

ru.L: Ведь я стал как мех в дыму; {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} установлений я не забыл.
ru.B: Я как кожаный мех, высохший и потрескавшийся в дыму, но {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} установления не ушли из моей памяти.
ru.R: Я высох и стал бесполезен, как старый кожаный мешок, что висит в дыму. Но я не забыл {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} законов.

uk.L: Бо я став, як міх у диму; {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} постанов я не забув.
uk.B: Я як шкіряний міх, що висох і потріскався в диму, та {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} постанови не вилетіли мені з памʼяті.
uk.R: Я висохлий і непотрібний, як старий шкіряний міх, що висить у диму. Але я не забув {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} законів.

decisions.choice: a wineskin in smoke: shriveled and useless
decisions.reason: Wine and water were kept in bottles made of animal skin. One hung in the smoke of a fire, in a house without a chimney, would dry out, blacken and crack.
The word (ki) may give the reason for the cry in verse 82, or mean "though", leading to the second line.

decisions.choice: statutes: rules that are fixed and laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:5.
Readable says what the picture means (m1).

source.text: כַּמָּ֥ה יְמֵֽי־עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ מָתַ֬י תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה בְרֹדְפַ֣י מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: How many [are the] days of your servant? When will you do on [those] pursuing me judgment?

en.L: How many [are] the days of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant? When will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} execute judgment on those who pursue me?
en.B: How many days does {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servant have left? When will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} judge those who hunt me down?
en.R: I do not have long to live. When will {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} bring the people who chase me to justice?

fr.L: Combien [sont] les jours de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur ? Quand exerceras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} le jugement sur ceux qui me poursuivent ?
fr.B: Combien de jours reste-t-il à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} serviteur ? Quand jugeras-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ceux qui me traquent ?
fr.R: Il ne me reste plus longtemps à vivre. Quand vas-{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} traduire en justice ceux qui me poursuivent ?

sw.L: Siku za mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} [ni] ngapi? Utatekeleza lini hukumu juu ya wale wanaonifuatia?
sw.B: Mtumishi {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} amebakiwa na siku ngapi? Utawahukumu lini wale wanaoniwinda?
sw.R: Sina muda mrefu wa kuishi. Utawahukumu lini watu wanaonifukuza?

es.L: ¿Cuántos [son] los días de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo? ¿Cuándo harás juicio contra los que me persiguen?
es.B: ¿Cuántos días le quedan a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} siervo? ¿Cuándo juzgarás a los que me acosan?
es.R: No me queda mucho tiempo de vida. ¿Cuándo llevarás {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} ante la justicia a los que me persiguen?

vi.L: Các ngày của đầy tớ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] bao nhiêu? Khi nào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ thi hành sự phán xét trên những kẻ bắt bớ tôi?
vi.B: Đầy tớ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn được bao nhiêu ngày nữa? Khi nào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ xét xử những kẻ săn đuổi tôi?
vi.R: Tôi không còn sống được bao lâu nữa. Khi nào {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ đem những kẻ đuổi bắt tôi ra xét xử?

ko.L: 주님의 종의 날들이 얼마나 됩니까? 저를 쫓는 자들에게 주님께서 언제 심판을 행하시겠습니까?
ko.B: 주님의 종에게 남은 날이 얼마나 됩니까? 저를 뒤쫓는 자들을 주님께서 언제 심판하시겠습니까?
ko.R: 저는 살날이 얼마 남지 않았습니다. 저를 쫓는 사람들을 주님께서 언제 벌하시겠습니까?

pt.L: Quantos [são] os dias do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo? Quando {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} executarás juízo sobre os que me perseguem?
pt.B: Quantos dias restam ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} servo? Quando {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} julgarás os que me caçam?
pt.R: Eu não tenho muito tempo de vida. Quando {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} vais levar à justiça as pessoas que me perseguem?

am.L: የባሪያህ ዘመን ስንት ነው? በሚያሳድዱኝ ላይ መቼ ፍርድን ታደርጋለህ?
am.B: አገልጋይህ ስንት ቀን ቀረው? የሚያሳድዱኝን መቼ ትፈርድባቸዋለህ?
am.R: ብዙ ዕድሜ አልቀረኝም። የሚያሳድዱኝን ሰዎች መቼ ለፍርድ ታቀርባቸዋለህ?

hi.L: तेरे दास के दिन कितने [हैं]? तू मेरा पीछा करनेवालों पर कब न्याय करेगा?
hi.B: तेरे दास के कितने दिन बचे हैं? तू कब उनका न्याय करेगा जो मेरा पीछा करते हैं?
hi.R: मेरे पास जीने के लिए अधिक समय नहीं है। तू कब उन लोगों का न्याय करेगा जो मेरे पीछे पड़े हैं?

ru.L: Сколько дней у {{deity_pronoun:твоего|Твоего}} раба? Когда {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} совершишь суд над моими преследователями?
ru.B: Сколько дней осталось {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} рабу? Когда {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} будешь судить тех, кто травит меня?
ru.R: Мне недолго осталось жить. Когда {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} призовёшь к ответу тех, кто гонится за мной?

uk.L: Скільки [є] днів {{deity_pronoun:твого|Твого}} раба? Коли {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} вчиниш суд над тими, хто мене переслідує?
uk.B: Скільки днів лишилося {{deity_pronoun:твоєму|Твоєму}} рабові? Коли {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} осудиш тих, хто полює на мене?
uk.R: Мені недовго лишилося жити. Коли {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} покараєш людей, які за мною женуться?

decisions.choice: how many are the days of your servant: my life is short
decisions.reason: The question means that the psalmist's life is short and he cannot wait long for God to act (39:5; 89:48).

Here the word (mishpat) is not one of the psalm's words for God's law but its usual sense: God's verdict on those who wrong the psalmist. This is one of the few verses of the psalm with none of the eight words.
The verb (radaf) is to chase someone down, as in verse 86.

decisions.choice: I do not have long to live
alternatives: how many are the days of your servant?
decisions.reason: Readable says what the question means (m1).

decisions.choice: "sự phán xét" (L); "xét xử" (B, R) for mishpat here, not "phán quyết"
alternatives: "phán quyết", the psalm's word for God's rulings
decisions.reason: Here mishpat is not one of the psalm's words for God's law but God's act of judging those who wrong the psalmist (see the meaning decision), so the sense is followed and the psalm's fixed word is not used.

decisions.choice: executarás juízo (L); julgarás (B); levar à justiça (R)
decisions.reason: Here mishpat has its ordinary sense, God's verdict on the psalmist's persecutors (m2), not the psalm's term for God's law, so it does not take the term's wording at Balanced and Readable; the Portuguese follows the English "execute judgment", "judge", "bring to justice".

decisions.choice: judgment as "ፍርድ" (singular), the word used for God's judgments in the psalm
decisions.reason: Here the word is the judging God will carry out on the persecutors, a ruling, so it keeps "ፍርድ"; verse 121 uses "ፍትሕ" where it means justice done.

Here the singular mishpat is God's act of judging the persecutors, not one of his rulings, so Hindi says "न्याय करना" and keeps "नियम" / "फ़ैसले" for the term, as the English keeps "judgments" / "decisions" apart from "execute judgment" / "bring to justice".
Here mishpat is the act of judging (m2), not one of God's rulings, so it is not the psalm's word "правила".

source.text: כָּֽרוּ־לִ֣י זֵדִ֣ים שִׁיח֑וֹת אֲ֝שֶׁ֗ר לֹ֣א כְתוֹרָתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] arrogant have dug for me pits, which [are] not according to your instruction.

en.L: The arrogant have dug pits for me, which [is] not according to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction.
en.B: The proud have dug pits to catch me, people who do not live by {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instruction.
en.R: Proud people have dug holes to trap me. They do not follow {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} teaching.

fr.L: Les orgueilleux ont creusé pour moi des fosses, ce qui n’[est] pas selon {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} loi.
fr.B: Les orgueilleux ont creusé des fosses pour me prendre, eux qui ne vivent pas selon {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} instruction.
fr.R: Les orgueilleux ont creusé des trous pour me piéger. Ils ne suivent pas {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} enseignement.

sw.L: Wenye kiburi wamenichimbia mashimo, jambo lisilo kulingana na mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Wenye kiburi wamechimba mashimo ili kunikamata, watu wasioishi kwa mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Watu wenye kiburi wamechimba mashimo ili kuninasa. Hawayafuati mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

es.L: Los soberbios me han cavado fosas, lo cual no [es] conforme a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción.
es.B: Los orgullosos han cavado fosas para atraparme; son gente que no vive según {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} instrucción.
es.R: Los orgullosos han cavado hoyos para atraparme. No siguen {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} enseñanza.

vi.L: Những kẻ kiêu ngạo đã đào hố cho tôi, [điều] không theo sự dạy dỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Những kẻ kiêu căng đã đào hố để bắt tôi, là những kẻ không sống theo lời dạy dỗ của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Những kẻ kiêu ngạo đã đào hố để gài bẫy tôi. Chúng không làm theo lời dạy của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 교만한 자들이 저를 [잡으려고] 구덩이들을 팠으니, 그것은 주님의 가르침을 따르지 않는 것입니다.
ko.B: 교만한 자들이 저를 잡으려고 구덩이를 팠습니다. 그들은 주님의 가르침대로 살지 않는 자들입니다.
ko.R: 교만한 사람들이 저를 빠뜨리려고 구덩이를 팠습니다. 그들은 주님의 가르침을 따르지 않습니다.

pt.L: Os arrogantes cavaram covas para mim, o que não [é] conforme o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} ensino.
pt.B: Os orgulhosos cavaram buracos para me apanhar, gente que não vive pelo {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} ensino.
pt.R: Pessoas orgulhosas cavaram buracos para me prender. Elas não seguem os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} ensinamentos.

am.L: ትዕቢተኞች ጉድጓዶችን ቆፈሩልኝ፤ ይህም እንደ ሕግህ አይደለም።
am.B: ሕግህን የማይከተሉ ትዕቢተኞች ሊያጠምዱኝ ጉድጓድ ቆፈሩ።
am.R: ትዕቢተኞች ሊያጠምዱኝ ጉድጓዶች ቆፈሩ። ሕግህን አይከተሉም።

hi.L: अभिमानियों ने मेरे लिए गड्ढे खोदे हैं, जो तेरी व्यवस्था के अनुसार नहीं [है]।
hi.B: अभिमानियों ने मुझे फँसाने के लिए गड्ढे खोदे हैं, वे लोग जो तेरी व्यवस्था के अनुसार नहीं चलते।
hi.R: घमंडी लोगों ने मुझे फँसाने के लिए गड्ढे खोदे हैं। वे तेरी शिक्षा पर नहीं चलते।

ru.L: Надменные выкопали для меня ямы, что не по {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} Закону.
ru.B: Гордые выкопали ямы, чтобы поймать меня, — люди, которые не живут по {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} Закону.
ru.R: Гордые люди выкопали ямы, чтобы поймать меня в ловушку. Они не следуют {{deity_pronoun:твоему|Твоему}} наставлению.

uk.L: Зарозумілі викопали для мене ями, що не за {{deity_pronoun:твоєю|Твоєю}} настановою.
uk.B: Горді викопали ями, щоб мене зловити, — люди, які не живуть за {{deity_pronoun:твоєю|Твоєю}} настановою.
uk.R: Горді люди викопали ями, щоб заманити мене в пастку. Вони не йдуть за {{deity_pronoun:твоїм|Твоїм}} навчанням.

decisions.reason: Hunters dug pits and covered them over to trap animals (7:16; 57:7).

decisions.choice: which: the people, or what they do
decisions.reason: "Which" may refer to the arrogant, who do not live by God's instruction, or to their digging of pits, which his instruction forbids. The sense is the same.
As in 119:1.

records.literal_gloss: All your commands [are] faithfulness; [with] falsehood they have pursued me; help me!

en.L: All {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands [are] faithfulness; with falsehood they have pursued me; help me!
en.B: All {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands can be trusted; people hunt me down with lies. Help me!
en.R: All {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} commands are true and can be trusted. People are chasing me with lies. Help me!

fr.L: Tous {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements [sont] fidélité ; par le mensonge ils m’ont poursuivi ; aide-moi !
fr.B: Tous {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements sont dignes de confiance ; on me traque avec des mensonges. Aide-moi !
fr.R: Tous {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} commandements sont vrais, on peut leur faire confiance. Des gens me poursuivent avec des mensonges. Aide-moi !

sw.L: Amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zote [ni] uaminifu; kwa uongo wamenifuatia; unisaidie!
sw.B: Amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zote zinaaminika; watu wananiwinda kwa uongo. Unisaidie!
sw.R: Amri {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} zote ni za kweli na zinaaminika. Watu wananifukuza kwa uongo. Unisaidie!

es.L: Todos {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos [son] fidelidad; con mentira me persiguen; ¡ayúdame!
es.B: Todos {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos son dignos de confianza; me acosan con mentiras. ¡Ayúdame!
es.R: Todos {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} mandamientos son verdaderos y se puede confiar en ellos. La gente me persigue con mentiras. ¡Ayúdame!

vi.L: Mọi điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] sự thành tín; chúng đã bắt bớ tôi bằng điều dối trá; xin giúp tôi!
vi.B: Mọi điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đều đáng tin cậy; người ta dùng lời dối trá săn đuổi tôi. Xin giúp tôi!
vi.R: Mọi điều răn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đều chân thật và đáng tin cậy. Người ta đang đuổi bắt tôi bằng những lời dối trá. Xin giúp tôi!

ko.L: 주님의 모든 계명들은 신실합니다. 거짓으로 그들이 저를 쫓습니다. 저를 도와주십시오!
ko.B: 주님의 모든 계명은 믿을 수 있습니다. 사람들이 거짓말로 저를 몰아붙입니다. 저를 도와주십시오!
ko.R: 주님의 명령은 모두 참되고 믿을 만합니다. 사람들이 거짓말을 하며 저를 쫓아옵니다. 저를 도와주십시오!

pt.L: Todos os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} mandamentos [são] fidelidade; com falsidade me perseguiram; ajuda-me!
pt.B: Todos os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} mandamentos merecem confiança; há gente me caçando com mentiras. Ajuda-me!
pt.R: Todos os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} mandamentos são verdadeiros e merecem confiança. Há pessoas me perseguindo com mentiras. Ajuda-me!

am.L: ትእዛዛትህ ሁሉ ታማኝነት [ናቸው]፤ በሐሰት አሳደዱኝ፤ እርዳኝ!
am.B: ትእዛዛትህ ሁሉ የሚታመኑ ናቸው፤ ሰዎች በውሸት ያሳድዱኛል፤ እርዳኝ!
am.R: ትእዛዛትህ ሁሉ እውነትና የሚታመኑ ናቸው። ሰዎች በውሸት እያሳደዱኝ ነው። እርዳኝ!

hi.L: तेरी सब आज्ञाएँ सच्चाई [हैं]; वे झूठ के साथ मेरा पीछा करते हैं; मेरी सहायता कर!
hi.B: तेरी सब आज्ञाएँ भरोसे के योग्य हैं; लोग झूठ के सहारे मेरा पीछा करते हैं। मेरी सहायता कर!
hi.R: तेरी सब आज्ञाएँ सच्ची हैं और उन पर भरोसा किया जा सकता है। लोग झूठ लेकर मेरे पीछे पड़े हैं। मेरी सहायता कर!

ru.L: Все {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} заповеди — верность; ложью они преследовали меня; помоги мне!
ru.B: Всем {{deity_pronoun:твоим|Твоим}} заповедям можно доверять; люди травят меня ложью. Помоги мне!
ru.R: Все {{deity_pronoun:твои|Твои}} заповеди верны, и им можно доверять. Люди гонятся за мной с ложью. Помоги мне!

uk.L: Усі {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} заповіді — вірність; брехнею вони переслідують мене; допоможи мені!
uk.B: На всі {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} заповіді можна покластися; люди полюють на мене з брехнею. Допоможи мені!
uk.R: Усі {{deity_pronoun:твої|Твої}} заповіді правдиві, і на них можна покластися. Люди женуться за мною з брехнею. Допоможи мені!

decisions.choice: commands: what God has told his people to do
decisions.reason: As in 119:6.
As in 119:30: God's commands are steady and true.

decisions.choice: with falsehood: with lies, without cause
decisions.reason: The word (sheqer) is the one in verse 29; the psalmist is hunted by lies and for no reason.

source.text: כִּ֭מְעַט כִּלּ֣וּנִי בָאָ֑רֶץ וַ֝אֲנִ֗י לֹא־עָזַ֥בְתִּי פִקֻּודֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Almost they have made an end of me on the earth, but I, I have not forsaken your precepts.

en.L: Almost they have made an end of me on the earth, but as for me, I have not forsaken {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.B: They came close to finishing me off in the land, yet I have not let go of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} precepts.
en.R: They almost killed me, but I have not turned away from {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} instructions.

fr.L: Ils ont failli m’anéantir sur la terre, mais moi, je n’ai pas abandonné {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.B: Ils ont été près d’en finir avec moi dans le pays, mais je n’ai pas lâché {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} préceptes.
fr.R: Ils ont presque réussi à me tuer, mais je ne me suis pas détourné de {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} consignes.

sw.L: Karibu wamenimaliza duniani, lakini mimi sijayaacha maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.B: Walikaribia kunimaliza kabisa katika nchi, lakini sijayaacha maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.
sw.R: Walikaribia kuniua, lakini sijayaacha maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}.

es.L: Casi me han acabado en la tierra, pero yo no he abandonado {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} preceptos.
es.B: Estuvieron a punto de acabar conmigo en el país, pero yo no he soltado {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} preceptos.
es.R: Casi me mataron, pero yo no me he alejado de {{deity_pronoun:tus|Tus}} instrucciones.

vi.L: Chúng gần như đã diệt tôi khỏi mặt đất, nhưng còn tôi, tôi đã không lìa bỏ các huấn lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Chúng suýt nữa đã tiêu diệt tôi trong xứ, nhưng tôi vẫn không buông các huấn lệnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Chúng suýt giết chết tôi, nhưng tôi không quay lưng với những lời chỉ dẫn của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그들이 땅에서 저를 거의 끝장낼 뻔했으나, 저는 주님의 법도들을 버리지 않았습니다.
ko.B: 그들이 이 땅에서 저를 거의 없애 버릴 뻔했지만, 저는 주님의 법도를 놓지 않았습니다.
ko.R: 그들이 저를 거의 죽일 뻔했지만, 저는 주님의 지시에서 돌아서지 않았습니다.

pt.L: Quase acabaram comigo na terra, mas eu não abandonei os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} preceitos.
pt.B: Por pouco não me liquidaram na terra; mesmo assim não larguei os {{deity_pronoun:teus|Teus}} preceitos.
pt.R: Eles quase me mataram, mas eu não me afastei das {{deity_pronoun:tuas|Tuas}} instruções.

am.L: በምድር ላይ ሊያጠፉኝ ጥቂት ቀራቸው፤ እኔ ግን መመሪያዎችህን አልተውኩም።
am.B: በምድሪቱ ላይ ሊጨርሱኝ ተቃርበው ነበር፤ እኔ ግን መመሪያዎችህን አልለቀቅኩም።
am.R: ሊገድሉኝ ጥቂት ቀርቷቸው ነበር፤ እኔ ግን ከመመሪያዎችህ ዘወር አላልኩም።

hi.L: उन्होंने पृथ्वी पर से लगभग मेरा अंत कर दिया, पर मैंने तेरे आदेशों को नहीं त्यागा।
hi.B: वे देश में मुझे लगभग मिटा चुके थे, फिर भी मैंने तेरे आदेशों को नहीं छोड़ा।
hi.R: उन्होंने मुझे लगभग मार ही डाला था, पर मैंने तेरे निर्देशों से मुँह नहीं मोड़ा।

ru.L: Едва не покончили они со мной на земле, но я не оставил {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} наказов.
ru.B: Они чуть было не погубили меня в этой стране, но я не выпустил из рук {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} наказов.
ru.R: Они чуть не убили меня, но я не отвернулся от {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} указаний.

uk.L: Ледь не знищили мене на землі, а я не покинув {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} наказів.
uk.B: Вони майже доконали мене в краю, та я не відпустив {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} наказів.
uk.R: Вони ледь не вбили мене, але я не відвернувся від {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} вказівок.

decisions.reason: The verb is the one in verses 81-82 (kalah), here "finish off".
The word ('erets) can mean the whole earth or the land.

decisions.choice: precepts: the charges God has laid down
decisions.reason: As in 119:4.

records.literal_gloss: According to your loyal love give me life, and I will keep [the] testimony of your mouth.

en.L: According to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love give me life, and I will keep the testimony of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} mouth.
en.B: Keep me alive in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} loyal love, and I will hold to the decree {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have spoken.
en.R: Keep me alive because of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithful love, and I will obey what {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have declared.

fr.L: Selon {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour loyal fais-moi vivre, et je garderai le témoignage de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bouche.
fr.B: Garde-moi en vie dans {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle, et je m’attacherai au décret que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as prononcé.
fr.R: Garde-moi en vie à cause de {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} amour fidèle, et j’obéirai à ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as déclaré.

sw.L: Kulingana na upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma unihuishe, nami nitaushika ushuhuda wa kinywa {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}}.
sw.B: Unihuishe katika upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, nami nitaushika ushuhuda ulioutamka.
sw.R: Uniweke hai kwa sababu ya upendo {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} usiokoma, nami nitautii ushuhuda ulioutamka.

es.L: Conforme a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor leal dame vida, y guardaré el testimonio de {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} boca.
es.B: Dame vida por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel, y me mantendré fiel al decreto que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has pronunciado.
es.R: Mantenme con vida por {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} amor fiel, y obedeceré lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has declarado.

vi.L: Theo tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, xin ban sự sống cho tôi, và tôi sẽ giữ lời chứng của miệng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Xin giữ cho tôi được sống trong tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và tôi sẽ giữ vững lời chứng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã phán ra.
vi.R: Xin giữ cho tôi được sống vì tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và tôi sẽ vâng theo những điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã công bố.

ko.L: 주님의 한결같은 사랑대로 저를 살려 주십시오. 그러면 제가 주님의 입의 증언을 지키겠습니다.
ko.B: 주님의 한결같은 사랑으로 저를 살려 주십시오. 그러면 주님께서 말씀하신 증언을 굳게 지키겠습니다.
ko.R: 주님의 변함없는 사랑으로 저를 살려 주십시오. 그러면 주님께서 알려 주신 뜻을 따르겠습니다.

pt.L: Conforme o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal dá-me vida, e guardarei o testemunho da {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} boca.
pt.B: Mantém-me vivo no {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor leal, e eu me apegarei ao decreto que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} pronunciaste.
pt.R: Mantém-me vivo por causa do {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} amor fiel, e eu vou obedecer ao que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} declaraste.

am.L: እንደ ጽኑ ፍቅርህ ሕያው አድርገኝ፤ የአፍህንም ምስክርነት እጠብቃለሁ።
am.B: በጽኑ ፍቅርህ ሕያው አድርገኝ፤ የተናገርከውንም ምስክርነት እጠብቃለሁ።
am.R: ስለ ጽኑ ፍቅርህ ሕያው አድርገኝ፤ የተናገርከውንም ምስክርነት እጠብቃለሁ።

hi.L: अपने अटल प्रेम के अनुसार मुझे जीवन दे, और मैं तेरे मुँह की चितौनी का पालन करूँगा।
hi.B: अपने अटल प्रेम में मुझे जीवित रख, और मैं तेरी कही हुई चितौनी को थामे रहूँगा।
hi.R: अपने अटल प्रेम के कारण मुझे जीवित रख, और मैं तेरी घोषणा का पालन करूँगा।

ru.L: По {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} неизменной любви дай мне жизнь, и я буду хранить свидетельство {{deity_pronoun:твоих|Твоих}} уст.
ru.B: Сохрани мне жизнь по {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} неизменной любви, и я буду держаться постановления, которое произнёс {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}.
ru.R: Сохрани мне жизнь по {{deity_pronoun:твоей|Твоей}} неизменной любви, и я буду исполнять то, что {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} возвестил.

uk.L: За {{deity_pronoun:твоєю|Твоєю}} незмінною любовʼю оживи мене, і я берегтиму свідчення {{deity_pronoun:твоїх|Твоїх}} уст.
uk.B: Бережи мене живим у {{deity_pronoun:твоїй|Твоїй}} незмінній любові, і я триматимусь свідчення, яке {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} промовив.
uk.R: Збережи мені життя через {{deity_pronoun:твою|Твою}} вірну любов, і я слухатимусь того, що {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} проголосив.

decisions.choice: give me life: keep me alive, renew my life
testimonies: what God has solemnly declared
decisions.reason: As in 119:2; here the word is singular ('edut).
As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

records.literal_gloss: Forever, YHWH, your word [is] standing firm in the heavens.

en.L: Forever, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word [is] standing firm in the heavens.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word lasts forever; it is fixed in place in the heavens.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} word lasts forever. It is set firmly in heaven, where nothing can shake it.

fr.L: Pour toujours, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole [se tient] ferme dans les cieux.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole dure pour toujours ; elle est fixée dans les cieux.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} parole dure pour toujours. Elle est établie solidement dans le ciel, où rien ne peut l’ébranler.

sw.L: Milele, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} [limesimama] imara mbinguni.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} linadumu milele; limewekwa imara mbinguni.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, neno {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} linadumu milele. Limesimikwa imara mbinguni, mahali ambapo hakuna kitu kinachoweza kulitikisa.

es.L: Para siempre, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra [está] firme en los cielos.
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra permanece para siempre; está fija en su lugar en los cielos.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} palabra dura para siempre. Está firme en el cielo, donde nada la puede mover.

vi.L: Đến đời đời, lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [vẫn] đứng vững trên các tầng trời.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời; lời ấy được lập vững trên các tầng trời.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, lời của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn mãi mãi. Lời ấy được đặt vững chắc trên trời, nơi không gì có thể lay chuyển được.

ko.L: 영원히, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 말씀이 하늘에 굳게 서 있습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 말씀은 영원합니다. 하늘에 굳게 세워져 있습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 말씀은 영원히 있습니다. 아무것도 흔들 수 없는 하늘에 단단히 자리 잡고 있습니다.

pt.L: Para sempre, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra [se mantém] de pé nos céus.
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra dura para sempre; está fixada no seu lugar nos céus.
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} palavra dura para sempre. Ela está bem firme no céu, onde nada pode abalá-la.

am.L: ለዘላለም፣ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ቃልህ በሰማያት ጸንቶ ይቆማል።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ቃልህ ለዘላለም ይኖራል፤ በሰማይ ጸንቶ ተተክሏል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ቃልህ ለዘላለም ይኖራል። ምንም ሊያናውጠው በማይችልበት በሰማይ በጽኑ ተመሥርቷል።

hi.L: सदा के लिए, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तेरा वचन स्वर्ग में स्थिर [है]।
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तेरा वचन सदा बना रहता है; वह स्वर्ग में अटल रूप से स्थापित है।
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, तेरा वचन सदा बना रहता है। वह स्वर्ग में ऐसा स्थिर है कि उसे कोई हिला नहीं सकता।

ru.L: Навсегда, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} слово поставлено на небесах.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} слово вечно; оно прочно утверждено на небесах.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, {{deity_pronoun:твоё|Твоё}} слово будет всегда. Оно твёрдо стоит на небе, где ничто не может его поколебать.

uk.L: Навіки, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} слово стоїть твердо на небесах.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} слово триває навіки; воно непорушно закріплене на небесах.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, {{deity_pronoun:твоє|Твоє}} слово триває вічно. Воно міцно стоїть на небі, де ніщо не може його похитнути.

decisions.reason: Each of the eight verses of this stanza begins with the letter lamed, the twelfth letter of the Hebrew alphabet (see 119:1).

decisions.choice: standing firm: set in place, stationed
decisions.reason: The verb (nitsav) is used of something set up to stand, like a pillar or a guard at his post. God's word is as fixed as the heavens where he reigns (verses 90-91).
The word (davar) is the broadest of the psalm's eight terms for what God has made known: anything he has spoken, whether command or promise.
Readable spells out what it means for the word to stand firm in heaven.

source.text: לְדֹ֣ר וָ֭דֹר אֱמֽוּנָתֶ֑ךָ כּוֹנַ֥נְתָּ אֶ֝֗רֶץ וַֽתַּעֲמֹֽד׃

records.literal_gloss: To generation and generation [is] your faithfulness; you established [the] earth, and it stands.

en.L: To generation and generation [is] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} faithfulness; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} established the earth, and it stands.
en.B: Your faithfulness lasts from one generation to the next; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} set the earth in its place, and it remains.
en.R: You stay faithful to people in every age. You made the earth firm, and it is still standing.

fr.L: De génération en génération [est] {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} fidélité ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as établi la terre, et elle tient.
fr.B: Ta fidélité dure d’une génération à l’autre ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as mis la terre à sa place, et elle demeure.
fr.R: Tu restes fidèle aux gens de toutes les époques. Tu as rendu la terre solide, et elle tient encore.

sw.L: Kizazi hata kizazi [ni] uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}}; uliiweka imara dunia, nayo inasimama.
sw.B: Uaminifu {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} unadumu kizazi hadi kizazi; uliiweka dunia mahali pake, nayo inadumu.
sw.R: Unabaki mwaminifu kwa watu wa kila kizazi. Uliifanya dunia imara, nayo bado imesimama.

es.L: De generación en generación [es] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} fidelidad; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} afirmaste la tierra, y permanece.
es.B: Tu fidelidad dura de una generación a otra; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} pusiste la tierra en su lugar, y allí sigue.
es.R: Tú sigues siendo fiel a la gente de todas las épocas. Tú hiciste firme la tierra, y todavía sigue en pie.

vi.L: Từ đời này sang đời kia [là] sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lập nền đất, và nó đứng vững.
vi.B: Sự thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn từ thế hệ này sang thế hệ khác; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã đặt đất vào chỗ của nó, và đất vẫn còn đó.
vi.R: Ngài luôn thành tín với con người trong mọi thời đại. Ngài đã làm cho đất vững chắc, và đất vẫn đứng vững đến nay.

ko.L: 대대로 주님의 신실하심이 [있습니다]. 주님께서 땅을 세우셨으니, 그것이 서 있습니다.
ko.B: 주님의 신실하심은 대대로 이어집니다. 주님께서 땅을 제자리에 세우셨으니, 땅이 그대로 있습니다.
ko.R: 주님께서는 어느 시대 사람들에게나 늘 신실하십니다. 주님께서 땅을 단단하게 만드셨기에 땅이 지금도 서 있습니다.

pt.L: De geração em geração [é] a {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} fidelidade; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} estabeleceste a terra, e ela fica de pé.
pt.B: A {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} fidelidade dura de uma geração à outra; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} puseste a terra no seu lugar, e ela continua firme.
pt.R: Tu continuas fiel às pessoas em todas as épocas. Tu fizeste a terra firme, e ela ainda está de pé.

am.L: ታማኝነትህ ለትውልድና ለትውልድ [ነው]፤ ምድርን መሠረትካት፤ እርሷም ጸንታ ትኖራለች።
am.B: ታማኝነትህ ከትውልድ እስከ ትውልድ ይኖራል፤ ምድርን በስፍራዋ አጸናሃት፤ እርሷም ጸንታለች።
am.R: በየዘመኑ ላሉ ሰዎች ታማኝ ሆነህ ትኖራለህ። ምድርን አጸናሃት፤ እርሷም አሁንም ቆማለች።

hi.L: पीढ़ी से पीढ़ी तक तेरी सच्चाई [है]; तूने पृथ्वी को स्थिर किया, और वह बनी रहती है।
hi.B: तेरी विश्वासयोग्यता एक पीढ़ी से दूसरी पीढ़ी तक बनी रहती है; तूने पृथ्वी को उसके स्थान पर रखा, और वह टिकी हुई है।
hi.R: तू हर युग के लोगों के प्रति विश्वासयोग्य रहता है। तूने पृथ्वी को दृढ़ किया, और वह आज भी टिकी हुई है।

ru.L: Из рода в род — {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} верность; {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} утвердил землю, и она стоит.
ru.B: Твоя верность длится от поколения к поколению; {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} поставил землю на её место, и она пребывает.
ru.R: Ты остаёшься верен людям во все времена. Ты сделал землю прочной, и она всё ещё стоит.

uk.L: З роду в рід — {{deity_pronoun:твоя|Твоя}} вірність; {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} утвердив землю, і вона стоїть.
uk.B: Твоя вірність триває від покоління до покоління; {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} поставив землю на її місце, і вона стоїть.
uk.R: Ти залишаєшся вірним людям у кожну епоху. Ти зробив землю міцною, і вона досі стоїть.

decisions.choice: to generation and generation: through all generations
decisions.reason: The doubled word means every generation in turn, without end.

decisions.choice: it stands: it endures, it stays in place
decisions.reason: The verb ('amad) is to stand. The earth God set up has not fallen; verse 91 uses the same verb of all creation.

source.text: לְֽ֭מִשְׁפָּטֶיךָ עָמְד֣וּ הַיּ֑וֹם כִּ֖י הַכֹּ֣ל עֲבָדֶֽיךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: By your judgments they stand this day, for everything [are] your servants.

en.L: By {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} judgments they stand this day, for all things [are] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants.
en.B: They stand today by {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} rulings, since all things are {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} servants.
en.R: Heaven and earth are still here today because of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} decisions. Everything there is serves {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

fr.L: Par {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} jugements ils se tiennent aujourd’hui, car toutes choses [sont] {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} esclaves.
fr.B: Ils subsistent aujourd’hui selon {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décisions, car toutes choses sont à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} service.
fr.R: Le ciel et la terre sont encore là aujourd’hui grâce à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décisions. Tout ce qui existe {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} sert.
